items.title: CD Projekt 的《赛博朋克 2077》Loremaster 确认《Edgerunners 2》已定档，引发粉丝对佳能结局的猜测
items.summary: CD Projekt Red loremaster Patrick Mills has revealed the exact year Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 takes place, amid

others.title: Cyberpunk 2077 Is Celebrating Edgerunners Season 2 With A Surprise Update

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/19/cyberpunk-edgerunners-talia-thumb-1792444102039.jpg
CD Projekt Red loremaster Patrick Mills has revealed the exact year Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 takes place, amid speculation from fans about what it means for the ending of Cyberpunk 2077.
According to Mills, Season 2 takes place not long after you bite the bullet and finally meet Hanako at Embers in Cyberpunk 2077.

"Ok so the thing is that I am seeing a lot of people assuming S2 takes place before 2077 but it doesn't, it takes place in 2078," Mills confirmed in a post on Bluesky . "Moving things forward, time doesn't stop in Cyberpunk."
Mills previously posted about a misunderstanding he had seen in early reviews of the series, but wanted to wait until it was out before dropping a truth nuke.

In Edgerunners Season 2, powerful corporation Arasaka doesn’t quite have the same pull it did during the events of Cyberpunk 2077 , which is a hint that the anime takes place after the events of the game. There are also some other smaller and bigger details, but like the loremaster, I don’t want to spoil things for you.

Now they know Edgerunners 2 is set just a year after the events of Cyberpunk 2077, fans are trying to work out what it means for the plot of the game . Some believe it suggests certain endings are canon. Or, perhaps it would be better to say, some believe it suggests certain endings are not canon. In truth, Edgerunners 2 doesn't force CD Projekt into making a decision about canon — a bit like Bethesda's position on Fallout canon in the context of the Amazon TV show, which takes place after all the video games.

The world of Cyberpunk is set to expand further, of course, with the in-development Cyberpunk 2 (where and when the game takes place is yet to be announced). There's also a live-action film in the works, although according to CD Projekt, the Cyberpunk 2077 movie won't retrace the game's steps .

Before all that, Cyberpunk 2077 is set for a surprise Edgerunners 2-themed update this week. CD Projekt has confirmed it features cyberware customization and a new dual-wielding playstyle. CDPR released a similar update to tie into the first season. The Cyberpunk 2077 Edgerunners update added a short questline that let players track down the cool yellow jacket the protagonist of Season 1 wore. There’s a good chance the new update will come with some similar surprises when it drops on October 22.
More details about the Edgerunners 2 update will be revealed today, October 21, 2026, during a special episode of REDstreams.

content.v: Steam“新品节10月版”于2026年10月20日至27日2时举行。日媒4Gamer集中试玩约70款参展作品，并从中重点推荐6款，为玩家筛选仅凭商店介绍难以了解的实际操作体验。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261021/1792578257_510665_jpg_r.jpg
悬疑冒险游戏《天使机构 执行部灵魂救济课》
这是一个设定在超自然现象（被称为“灵异事件”）已成为日常生活一部分的世界中的神秘冒险故事。主人公追寻着各种事件背后的真相。故事讲述了隶属于专门调查灵异事件的“天使组织”的两名调查员，接手各种无法解释的案件。
游戏由三个部分组成：“对话”、“推理”和“营救”。游戏机制是这样的：首先在对话部分收集信息，然后根据这些信息进行推理，最后进入营救部分。在这个试玩版中，我们体验到了第一个案件推理部分的中段。
在推理部分，玩家可以通过窥探“亡灵的记忆”来还原事发当日的情况。这不仅仅是比对证词和证据，玩家还能体验到一种独特的整理信息、追溯记忆的感觉。
最吸引人的是它极高的画面表现力。独特的人物画风，以及与之完美契合的音效设计，都极大地增强了作品的氛围。信息的呈现方式也十分出色，让人越玩越沉浸其中。我已经迫不及待地想玩剩下的部分了！
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261021/1792578266_431146_jpg_r.jpg
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261021/1792578522_497244.jpg
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261021/1792578522_161038.jpg
《诏者：轮卡》
一款卡牌构筑类Roguelike游戏，玩家使用机械卡牌与敌人战斗。玩家扮演受“机械教条”委派的特工，任务是消灭敌对势力。游戏采用金属质感的用户界面和机械动画，带来震撼的沉浸式战斗体验，与传统卡牌游戏截然不同。
基本系统类似于传统的卡牌构筑型roguelike游戏，玩家使用手牌攻击敌人。然而，卡牌拥有“耐久度”，受到敌人攻击后会受到损伤。此外，战斗中受损的卡牌要到下一场战斗才会复活，因此决定保护哪些卡牌、牺牲哪些卡牌至关重要。最
显著的特点是，卡牌的耐久度与“手牌顺序”密切相关。由于手牌本身就是一种防御手段，因此受到的伤害量会根据卡牌的排列顺序而变化。例如，如果想要阻挡来自右侧的敌人攻击，就需要将那张会受到伤害的卡牌放在手牌的最右侧。
有趣的是，这消除了采取“防御行动”的必要性。由于无需将原本用于出牌的资源分配给防御，该系统鼓励玩家采取极具侵略性的打法和卡组构筑风格。
玩家可以通过附加特殊部件来强化卡牌，构建各种效果链也乐趣无穷。得益于其独特的防御系统，玩家在使用卡牌时需要做出自己的决策，这使得这款卡组构筑类roguelike游戏极具个性化。如果你喜欢卡组构筑游戏，那么绝对应该尝试一下这款游戏。

之前上千亿的投入，已经慢慢产出看得见的成果。芯片这边，小米自研玄戒系列芯片，玄戒O1出货量突破100万台，玄戒O3也已经正式商用，AI加速芯片、智驾芯片也在推进当中。
操作系统就是大家熟悉的澎湃OS，它把手机、汽车、家电的底层打通，新版本澎湃OS4搭配超级小爱2.0，跨设备联动的能力更强。
AI这边，小米MiMo大模型已经覆盖语言、多模态、语音完整的模型矩阵，端侧AI能力直接放到各类终端里面。
具身智能方向，小米人形机器人也已经落地工厂做测试，和小米汽车业务互相配合。汽车业务也跑出了规模，小米汽车上市两年半，累计交付超过80万台，均价超过26万元。
这次宣布加码之后，未来5年的投入规模直接翻了接近一倍，资金依旧会集中在底层硬核技术。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/21/small_202610212011337113.jpg
持续的研发投入，意味着后续小米在手机、汽车、智能家居、机器人等领域，带来更多让人眼前一亮的产品。

items.title: PS5 最大的实体游戏与其最大的数字热门游戏看起来截然不同
items.summary: The furore over Sony's decision to effectively kill physical games on its PlayStation platform appears to have

content.v: The furore over Sony's decision to effectively kill physical games on its PlayStation platform appears to have died down (for now), and new data from Alinea Analytics shows how wide the split between physical and digital PS5 games is in 2026. As Alinea's head of market analysis, Rhys Elliott, notes , PlayStation's top new 2026 games by physical copies are mostly single-player AAA titles, with Resident Evil Requiem the best-seller.

Capcom's hit Resident Evil game is estimated to have sold 1.3 million units on PS5, and it's also estimated to be the only game on the list to have broken the 1 million sales milestone. Other games like 007 First Light (873,000) and Marvel's Wolverine have come close (799,000), but overall, digital currently has a 70/30 sales lead.
Top PlayStation games by physical copies sold and revenues

As Elliott explained, PlayStation first-party and Japan-centric games typically shift more physical units, with sales of Capcom games like Pragmata and Onimusha: Way of the Sword almost split evenly between physical and digital this year. Physical sales accounted for 44.0% of Pragmata's copies sold so far and 44.1% of Onimusha's copies sold, thanks to Capcom's home market in Japan.

"Our estimates show that Japan accounts for 12% of Onimusha‘s copies sold on PlayStation, and 11% for Pragmata‘s. While digital shares are on the up in Japan, Japanese consumers still have a penchant for physical copies, more so than any Western market. It’s ingrained in the culture," Elliott wrote. "Our estimates show that Japan accounts for 12% of Onimusha‘s copies sold on PlayStation, and 11% for Pragmata‘s. While digital shares are on the up in Japan, Japanese consumers still have a penchant for physical copies, more so than any Western market. It’s ingrained in the culture."
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/onimusha.webp?w=636

Other games like Silent Hill: Townfall, Beast of Reincarnation, Yakuza Kiwami 3, and the Fatal Frame 2: Crimson Butterfly remake have also seen their sales split down the middle between physical and digital in Japan, but Sony is attempting to subtly persuade that market to go digital. The company recently released a digital-only PS5 exclusively in that region, at the tempting price of $350.

While Japan is something of an outlier when it comes to game medium preference, the rest of the world is a different story. Sports games are some of the best-sellers of any given year, and as Elliott pointed out, five of the top 10 games in 2026's new PlayStation games by revenue were all sports games. Only 8.9% of EA Sports FC 27 games sold this year were physical, while sales of NBA 2K27, Madden 27, College Football 27, and MLB The Show 26 also heavily favored digital sales.

Publishers have slowly nudged their audiences toward digital editions over the years, offering early access and other perks to encourage them. In comparison, the prestige single-player games that Sony became known for, are still popular with physical game collectors. It's easy to see why Sony wants to squeeze as much revenue juice out of its consumers as possible, as it loses out on extra potential cash with each physical sale. It has to hand a portion of sales over to retailers, fork over cash for various distribution costs, and the company probably isn't happy about it can't extract any cash from the second-hand game sales market.
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/EA-Sports-FC-27.jpg?w=636
Compare that to digital and third-party sports games, and you can see how Sony takes a 30% cut from a massive number of games sold on its marketplace, in a genre that is nearly all-digital.

"It's doubly ironic, given the whole move is about squeezing more revenue per player, and a lot of the highest revenue users are some of the people Sony's pissing off," Elliott concluded. "But no, PlayStation won't necessarily lose much revenue by switching to digital-only. Some players will walk, but most will move over to digital. The economics are sound. That wasn’t ever the issue (in my view, anyway). The issue’s been with messaging and giving players a proper off-ramp from physical. Sony is usually quiet and doesn’t talk much, which can sometimes be a strength. It hasn’t been a strength here."

items.title: 战锤 40,000：战争黎明 4 - Necron 和 AdMech 派别详细印象 | IGN 预览
items.summary: I had a great time getting chromed up with the Adeptus Mechanicus and the Necrons in Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/20/warhammer40k-dawnofwar4-finalpreview-blogroll-1792538474364.jpg
Key Preview Takeaways:

The Terminator-like Necrons and the cybernetic humans of the Adeptus Mechanicus make a very interesting match-up on the battlefields of Warhammer 40K. At first glance, you might ask yourself why Dawn of War 4 spent two of its faction slots on what could broadly be described as "robot guys." And certainly, they do have some similarities. But now that I've gotten to spend quite a bit of time with both, I can say that they certainly claim their own niches.
Rise of the Machines

While the demo I got to check out also included Space Marines and Orks, those missions were the exact same ones we covered extensively as part of our exclusive IGN First coverage earlier this year. Of course, they've gotten a lot of polish since then. But in terms of the campaign especially, it's a lot of stuff we've already covered. So go check those videos out if you haven't. Because here, I'm going to focus on the stuff that was brand new to me: the AdMech and the Necrons.

We got to see the first six missions of the AdMech campaign, and the tone is quite a bit different from the Orks. While we last left warbosses Guzcutta and Goregutz scrapping over who got to be da biggest boss, not really caring about who got in their way or why, playing as AdMech let me engage with the unfolding events on Kronus much more proactively.

It's the second campaign of the four if you want to go in chronological order, and your choices in the Ork campaign can carry over in certain ways. Whether you chose to elevate the beastboss or the warlord from the stars to power might affect what kinds of Ork enemies you face, for instance. But the Orks play more of a supporting role than anything in these six missions, as the followers of the Omnissiah are focused on the much deeper problem of the Necron presence on Kronus.

Our main hero for the AdMech is Potentia-Delta-9, a technoarchaeologist who often puts the quest for knowledge above the directives of her superiors. She eventually locks dendrites with Sek-Ix-23, a much more by-the-book machine cultist who doesn't appreciate her loose cannon way of doing things. Just like the Ork campaign eventually split off to let you play as Guzcutta or Goregutz, the AdMech story reaches a point where the Magos Dominate of Kronus – the highest-ranking commander of the Mechanicus forces – gives a final ultimatum to Potentia. You can continue playing as her and go rogue, or choose to take over as Sek-Ix and try to restore order.

The story structure is a bit different from the Ork campaign in that it's not actually a branching timeline here. The same story will play out either way, but Potentia's perspective on it is quite different from that of Sek-Ix. They eventually come together before the end, but I don't want to spoil exactly how. I enjoyed this campaign a fair bit more than the Ork one overall. The stakes are higher, the characters are more relatable, and there's some juicy intrigue and ancient secrets to dig into.
Battle Network

The AdMech faction plays very differently from the Orks, as well. They're highly ranged-focused, with basic Skitarii Rangers and Skitarii Vanguards as the backbone of their armies. Both prefer not to get into melee if they can help it. But Vanguards are a bit more durable and excel at medium range, while Rangers file in behind them to lay down fire from a distance. They also get access to Ruststalkers, deadly melee troops who are permanently cloaked until they enter combat or get very close to the enemy.

While these cybernetic humans do a lot of the dirty work, the AdMech specialists come from the higher tech Cult of the Omnissiah. Tracked Kataphron melt through armor with great ease and elite Kastelan Robot maniples transform the frontline into a chrome wall of death in the late game. They're an adaptable army that can get shredded in close quarters if you're not careful, but has tools for almost any situation.

Their buildings form a network called the Noosphere that grows in power the more structures are connected to it, granting bonuses to all structures in the network. This can increase the power of defensive turrets or the production speed of unit structures, for example. But you need either cheap, defenseless Cogitator Relays or more expensive Cognis turrets to link distant structures and resource points to the network, and anything that gets cut off from your main base loses all of the benefits of the Noosphere.

This makes the AdMech somewhat vulnerable to flanking and deep-strike tactics, and creates an interesting strategic question at the start of every match. Should I expand quickly to seize as many points as possible with these fragile, single-path networks? Or should I take it a bit slower and build in redundancies and more automated defenses? Both can work under certain circumstances.
March of Oblivion

The Necrons have some things in common with the AdMech playstyle, but they're also the most different of the four factions in terms of how their economy works. They are what I sometimes call a "goo faction," in that they want to spread their special kind of goo across the map. Think Zerg creep from Starcraft or Undead blight from Warcraft 3. Their specific goo is a green and black machine lattice that emanates from each Nexus of Dominion, fragile tower structures that also produce their only economic resource: dominion.

Basically, the Necron economy is based on how much of the map area you've managed to blanket in your power grid. This doesn't mean they don't care at all about resource points – capturing them can give powerful secondary benefits like reduced unit costs and increased production speed. But it does mean that they can keep expanding by going around heavily-defended points and gooping up uncontested corners of the map, which is a very interesting way to play.

The theme of the Necron army could be summed up by the declaration, "We are inevitable." Especially at the beginning of a match, they spread very slowly across the map. Swift scarabs are fast enough to seize some control points early, but don't have the staying power to hold them. Meanwhile, your core infantry unit, Necron Warriors, can even stand up to Space Marine Intercessors, but march incredibly slowly.

This makes certain map types that revolve around holding strategic points tricky for Necrons. They have some better fast units later, as well as limited access to teleportation. But against a swarmy faction like Orks, I usually had to resign myself to the fact that they would take an early lead in capture points, and I would simply have to wash over them like a slow-motion tide to wrap up the win decisively in the second half. Knowing when and where to commit is of the highest importance, because after deploying a wave of warriors or teleporting to a strategic location, the Necrons might not have a chance to pivot later.

They were only available in Skirmish, so I didn't get a great idea of what their campaign is about or who their face characters might be. But they're clearly getting set up as the big bads, so I'm interested to learn more about what their motives on Kronus will be.

items.title: 我玩过《战争黎明 4》的 2 个战役，它们就是我所希望的一切
items.summary: We're so back, baby!

content.v: An RTS is only as good as its campaign. Sure, it's the competitive multiplayer side of things that gives these games their long tail—StarCraft 2 has been the dominant RTS for 16 years for this very reason—but the bulk of initial players will first be seduced by the promise of a killer singleplayer romp. In this regard, Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War 4 has the juice.

I've had a couple of weeks to play around with two of the four campaigns—orks and Adeptus Mechanicus—along with the shorter, two-mission prologue featuring the Astra Militarum, and I've been able to set aside my fear that we'd be getting a repeat of Dawn of War 3's issues. Folks, I am loving these campaigns.
Lads, lads lads
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/aWdLYJ652C5kKxteCAKd4V-1920-80.jpg

Out of the prologue, I signed up with the orks. The greenskins are a good first pick, not just because this campaign comes first in the chronology, but because it's the most straightforward faction. Their units and buildings are the cheapest in the game, and it only takes a few minutes to recruit a basic army right out of the gate. If you just want to smash shit up, the orks are your guys.

This is not to say that you'll be steamrolling everything. You can lose that army even quicker than you recruited it if you just charge in blind. Orks might not be the brightest xenos in the universe, but their ruthlessness and rage is tempered by low cunning—something the campaign narrative leans into.

If you want to make the most out of your green tide of devastation, you'll want to do a bit of recon, figuring out what toys your opponents are playing with. This won't just determine the units you should recruit, but the wargear upgrades you give them as well. Like the tabletop game, you're given a lot of versatility, which includes being able to switch up the weapons on individual units, which in turn lets you handle specific threats more effectively.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/9eny7yZekoEkM96ETNG9zU-1920-80.jpg

The ork campaign is a fun one, full of large green idiots posturing, backstabbing and getting all charged up about the prospect of squashing humies. You'll start as the boss of a local band of angry lads, but then spacefaring orks fall from the sky, and their boss (a familiar face for Dawn of War vets) quickly decides the world of Kronos is his—the native orks aren't really OK with that.
It's a brilliantly designed map.

So a lot of this campaign is focused on this competition between the two groups. A particularly great mission sees you competing in a race with this ork interloper. The first side to destroy the Adeptus Mechanicus base wins the race and gets to be the big boss (not that orks are sportsmanlike or tend to honour deals).

The armies are separated and must push up their respective paths, with the UI showing who's winning. It's a brilliantly designed map, with a slight MOBA vibe because of its lane setup, but also featuring some spacious areas for big fights and base building, lots of chokepoints, and some elevated positions that you'll need your Stormboyz to overcome. Across most of it, you're separated from the other orks, but you can still see them pushing their way up the map, which I found even more effective than the UI when it came to lighting a fire under my arse. At the top and bottom of the map, however, the two sides are linked, which inspires a bunch of sneaky backstabbing.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/LMVrdYxuumHDcHHy3yJ58W-1920-80.png

Your opponent starts sending small forces to harass your base, keeping you on your toes, and then your main armies clash at the top of the map, near the Adeptus Mechanicus base. I had a vast green horde and a respectable lead, but the tech priests were able to hold me off for a wee while, giving my opponent time to catch up. It was the best way to end the mission: a climactic battle where I was squished between humans and enemy orks. When the last building crumbled, most of my army was gone, but it didn't matter—I'd won the challenge.

After the race, you pick a side—the local boyz or the invaders—for the rest of the campaign. Some of the maps and objectives are shared between the two paths, but you'll also encounter unique missions, story moments and, of course, you'll have very different commander units to play around with. It's a smart way to solve the one-and-done nature of RTS campaigns—you'll need to play twice to experience everything. And even within the same path, you're occasionally forced to make certain decisions that will affect future missions.

As a tabletop boy, I feel pretty well taken care of in DoW4. Not being a methodical turn-based romp, it's naturally going to feel different, but it's undeniably authentic. There's the adaptation of the wargear system that I mentioned above, of course, but things like stratagems and command points also make their way over from the tabletop version.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/s6w32rqBYnSyv4Hunn9n3V-1920-80.jpg

Command points can be earned by fighting and taking over capture points, which can then be spent on activating powerful abilities, the aforementioned stratagems. They've helped me turn the tide of battle more than a few times. They're all great. Whether I'm summoning some explosive squigs, calling down a random unit—which naturally obliterates anything in the landing zone—or psychically buffing my entire army by calling a WAAAGH!, stratagems always promise a good time, and they live up to it.
Stratagems always promise a good time, and they live up to it.

The orks are also just a delight to watch, with their exaggerated animations and colourful model design, flawlessly evoking the tabletop game. Zooming in and watching a melee scrum play out is well worth the sacrifice of battlefield visibility, especially with the synced up animations. King Art has expanded this system, so it doesn't just sync up units when there's a kill.

Now, it doesn't always work as advertised. I often see units flailing around and not hitting anything, but I've also witnessed plenty of flashy duels playing out. Broadly, DoW4's scraps have a high level of physicality, with clashes between forces feeling tangible and tactile. And with a couple of months between now and launch, hopefully it will look even better in the finished build.
Heavy metal
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/dGyFGGSQ37ca4zYCmUtnKW-1920-80.png

After I finished up with my ork besties, the Adeptus Mechanicus campaign was a big change of pace. This is the first time these nerds have featured in Dawn of War, but good things come to those who wait—whether it's Guinness or tech priests. It's a fun tonal shift from the brutality of the green lads, with the Adeptus Mechanicus being the scalpel to the ork's blunt instrument.

The structure of the Adeptus Mechanicus campaign is similar to its ork counterpart, in that there's a big rivalry that allows you, after a certain point, to pick one of two paths with different commanders. The ork and Adeptus Mechanicus campaigns, and their respective paths, still feel suitably different, however, with bespoke missions and distinct characters giving each a powerful flavour all their own.

Technoarchaeology and immortal machines—that's what you're getting into with the Adeptus Mechanicus. The Imperium's dogmatic tinkerers make for a high-tech, precise army as they attempt to thwart the awakened necron forces on Kronos. Like the ork campaign, it's blessed with lots of variety, boasting plenty of novel missions and deftly avoiding too much repetition.

content.v: 给孩子买块电话手表，家长现在可能还得先打听一件事： 班里其他孩子戴什么牌子。
定位、通话、续航，比完这些还不够。孩子想要的，可能是能和同学加上好友的那一款。
是的，咱们熟悉的小天才智能手表又双叒叕上热搜了。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/21/origin_6233492_7046892.jpg
据大象新闻、四川观察等媒体报道， 有家长吐槽，孩子指名要买小天才，理由是同学都在用，换个牌子加不上好友，担心自己融不进去。
凤凰网财经还提到一位母亲分享的经历：女儿原先戴小米手表，摔坏之后，她想继续考虑华为或者小米，女儿却坚持要换小天才。
鸭曾经看过一个小学生带着最新款的Apple Watch Ultra，当时还觉得这不得是校园里最靓的崽。
现在想想，戴这玩意是事实意义上的谁“理”你啊……
https://imggifb.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/21/origin_6233492_7046893.gif
不过，小天才和其他品牌的手表，并不是连电话都打不了。
小天才手表之间支持“碰一碰”添加好友； 跨品牌手表之间，可以正常添加通讯录、通话、收发短信。
基础联系可以，但最核心的好友互动，就是另一回事。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/21/origin_6233492_7046896.jpg
图片来源：微博 @四川观察
小天才没有接入微信、QQ，而是使用自己的微聊体系。
其他品牌手表能存下号码，但不能进入小天才的微聊、好友主页等社交空间。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/21/origin_6233492_7046895.jpg
家长关注的是能否联系上孩子，孩子可能更在意能否加入同学的聊天。
虽然，加不上手表好友，不等于现实里就交不到朋友，更不能说不用小天才的孩子一定会被孤立。
但如果孩子身边的朋友恰好都在用同一个系统，你有我没有……大伙都是从小时候过来的，懂得都懂哈。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/21/origin_6233492_7046894.jpg
对厂商来说，系统越封闭、用户越集中，自家产品的护城河就越高。
对家长来说，在选购的时候也就多了一个难以量化的参数，价格锚点也就随之改变。
例如今年8月发布的Z12少年版，定价2699元，接近2700元甚至比果表还贵。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/21/origin_6233492_7046898.jpg
哪怕选的是更便宜的型号，家长一旦想换个品牌，仍得考虑孩子能否方便地参与原来的同伴互动。
至于为啥不接入微信、QQ等通用社交软件，客服表示主要出于未成年人网络安全考虑，担心陌生人添加、不良信息和网络诈骗等风险。
客服还介绍，品牌自研的微聊体系中，添加好友需要家长App审核同意，系统会屏蔽涉黄涉暴等不良词汇。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/21/origin_6233492_7046897.jpg
图片来源：小红书
儿童产品要防陌生人骚扰，这个点确实很关键。
但当同班同学换了一个手表品牌，能不能在同样经过家长同意、同样有安全管理的前提下，获得更多互通能力？
新国标《儿童手表安全技术要求》将于2027年1月1日实施。 标准第4.18条写明，儿童智能手表允许不同品牌手表之间交换电话号码和昵称，而且这一功能应受手表管理端管理。
对具备蓝牙功能的手表，标准还规定了识别、配对和加密传输要求。家长管理端也应支持删除通讯录号码。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/21/origin_6233492_7046899.jpg
不过，它要解决的是不同牌子的手表怎么安全地交换联系方式，不等于小天才好友圈正式对外开放。
说到底，从商业上来说小天才的朋友圈就是苹果的iOS差不多，都是最大的护城河。
你让小天才开放朋友圈，等于是自己拆掉好不容易积累的封闭生态，把销量直接让给竞品……
是真办不到～

items.title: 丈夫1个拥抱妻子断了5根肋骨 老婆一天一杯咖啡
items.summary: 近日，江苏，男子一个“热情拥抱”，妻子瞬间蹲地，痛苦得起不来。

content.v: 据大众新闻报道，近日，江苏，男子一个“热情拥抱”，妻子瞬间蹲地，痛苦得起不来。
就医后胸部CT显示：5根肋骨骨折、1根骨裂。女子告诉记者，自己平时一天一杯咖啡，不晒太阳，还有些骨质疏松。医生表示，骤然过紧的环抱式挤压，足以对胸廓局部形成集中应力，造成肋骨损伤。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261021_zy_red_164_11/1132.jpg
当事人王先生坦言，当时拥抱力度正常，完全没想到会这么严重，“就抱了一下就骨折了”。医院给出的治疗方案是贴膏药、吃药、静养，不需要做手术。目前妻子已出院在家静养，每隔5天需要去医院复查一次。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261021_zy_red_164_11/1229.jpg
谈及妻子骨折的原因，王先生表示医生诊断主要是骨质疏松所致。他透露，妻子体重只有九十几斤，平时有减肥习惯，晚上不吃饭，且每天至少喝一杯咖啡。此外，妻子日常在自家店里经营，从家到店里开车只需两三分钟，却总是把自己裹得严严实实，几乎从不晒太阳。经历这次教训后，王先生表示，妻子目前以调养为主，也开始注意多晒太阳、多补钙。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261021_zy_red_164_11/1389.jpg
对此，武汉亚心总医院骨科副主任医师晏艳祥指出，年轻人因拥抱这一力量导致骨折的情况相当少见，这背后很可能与骨质疏松有关，骨质疏松与平时的生活习惯、饮食习惯有很大关系。王先生妻子平时很少晒太阳，又喝咖啡，咖啡因会促进钙的流失。此外，过量饮用浓茶、使用激素类药物等情况也会加速骨骼钙的流失。
晏艳祥建议，女性50岁以上、男性60岁以上，建议每年检查一次骨密度；有过骨质疏松性骨折、长期使用激素类药物的人群，也建议每年查一次。他强调，预防骨质疏松要合理补充钙和维生素D、多晒太阳、保持饮食结构合理，多吃含钙丰富的食物，适当做一些抗阻运动，也会对骨骼强度有好处。

content.v: 过去几年里，不少厂商都选择在OLED显示器上发力，更新迭代明显加快，可以选择的规格和型号也越来越多，逐步覆盖了整个中高端市场。凭借新一代QD-OLED面板更明亮、更准确的显示效果，三星主导了这一阶段的OLED显示器面板市场，出货量也处于领先位置。其次是LG，通过一系列新技术加入的WOLED面板，与三星占据了绝大部分市场。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261021/1792583526_374940_jpg_r.jpg
Omdia最新研究显示，2026年OLED显示器面板出货量预计比起2025年增长79%，达到610万片。其中华硕是最大的采购商，占了全球出货量的23%，接下来依次是微星、三星、冠捷、LG、戴尔电脑、宏碁和联想。随着更多产能转移及投产，预计2027年出货量将达到750万。

三星和LG一直是OLED显示器面板的主要供应商，但是现在TCL旗下的华星光电通过其喷墨打印 OLED（IJP OLED）技术，在2026年加入了新的竞争，打破了原有的竞争格局。华星光电在今年第三季度，通过其G5.5工厂开始为微星的商用级创作者显示器出货27英寸UHD 120Hz IJP OLED显示面板。另外华星光电新8.6代IJP OLED工厂计划于2027年末开始生产，提供更大尺寸的面板，包括32英寸和34英寸产品，刷新率可达700Hz。
此外，价格也是推动OLED显示器面板能、得到更广泛采用的关键。数据显示，主流27英寸240Hz OLED面板在2026年的降价幅度超过40%，更高端的OLED显示器面板价格在2026年上半年也贴近350美元价格区间，预计2027年将下探至300美元。

items.title: 《猩红沙漠》公布了未知的 DLC 功能，包括造船、浪漫和住房
items.summary: Pearl Abyss has pulled back the curtain on the upcoming Crimson Desert DLC, Charting the Unknown, revealing wh

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/21/marriage-1792581311395.png
Pearl Abyss has pulled back the curtain on the upcoming Crimson Desert DLC, Charting the Unknown, revealing what players can expect.

Charting the Unknown adds new stories, ocean exploration, romance, business management and expanded housing to an already feature-packed Pywel. We have everything you need to know about the major additions below.
The plot thickens…

There are character focused stories for playable characters Kliff, Damiane, and Oongka, who, having put the fight for the Greymanes and Pywell to bed, set out on new paths. They’ll encounter allies and threats “both old and new.” Based on the new overview video, these new individual character stories will be relatively involved, with cutscenes pushing the plot forward.
Ocean voyages and shipbuilding

The DLC expands the Great Ocean of Pywel area, which you might have crossed in the base game on the back of a dragon. After establishing the Greymane camp, you can unlock shipbuilding, then gather resources to build your own vessel and customize it before you set sail. Pearl Abyss said that you’ll fight enemies (there’s ship combat), establish new strongholds with the Greymanes, and earn new rewards.

You can craft your own dive suit to help you delve deeper into the ocean. “More secrets lie beneath the surface, where new underwater traversal methods let players dive below the waves to uncover sunken ruins, treasure and resources,” Pearl Abyss said, while showing off the ability to hitch a ride on the back of a sea creature.
Romance and marriage

If you earn the trust of certain characters you can develop romantic relationships and even marry, Pearl Abyss said. One potential romance option is Bari, the Witch of Kindness. Pictures shown reveal a number of dialogue options tied to this mechanic, including "Give a genuine compliment," and "Confess your feelings." “Close” companions may also visit the Greymane Camp to “spend some time together.”
Housing

As for housing, you will be able to design the structure of your home from the ground up, including the placement of walls, windows and other structural elements. This sounds fun: once you’ve liberated certain castles, you can claim them and decorate their interiors, turning it into a new home.
Business management

In the base game, once the Greymane camp was established, you could send comrades on missions to liberated strongholds. With the DLC, you can manage some of these locations directly. You can now lease facilities across Pywel, assign comrades and equipment, choose which goods to sell, and decide how best to run each business to grow its recognition and profits.
New boss challenges

Pearl Abyss said “seasoned fighters seeking a greater test” should consider the new challenge where players face a series of powerful bosses from across Pywel, one after another. If you do well, expect "valuable rewards."

As someone put Crimson Desert down some time ago having sunk over 100 hours into the game, I'm feeling the pull to return to the game for the DLC. Pearl Abyss' relentless pace of updates in the wake of Crimson Desert's launch earlier this year made significant improvements and added game-changing features, but the new systems and mechanics coming with Charting the Unknown clearly take things to a new level. Even if you're not into story side of things, there's plenty to fuss over. The business management system, for example, looks like tens of hours of gameplay alone. Then there's underwater exploration and what I'm sure will end up a fan-favorite: romance.
Crimson Desert Enhanced: Charting the Unknown launches on October 29, 2026 at 2pm PT, 5pm ET, 10pm UK time, on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X and S, and PC via Steam and the Epic Games Store.

items.title: 三星 80% 的数据中心内存已在 2027 年售出，这意味着 RAM 的价格预计将再次出现两位数的上涨，并且更有可能出现
items.summary: Next year isn't looking so hot for sensibly priced hardware upgrades either…

content.v: I'm clinging to the hope that the memory supply crisis resolves sooner rather than later as much as the next PC gamer. Unfortunately, judging by how much of next year's memory supply has been locked down by long term agreements, it looks like things are about to get much worse before they get better.
80% of Samsung's 2027 memory output has already been secured by long term agreements, according to Korean investment firm KB Securities (via Yonhap News ).

Hyperscalers pushing forward with the big data centre build out will likely be jostling for the remaining 20%. As for Samsung's commodity memory output—your DRAM, your NAND, and so on—70% is already said to be covered by five year contracts.

Yearly agreements account for 100% of the company's High Bandwidth Memory (HBM) output (which is most often used by graphics cards and accelerators for data centres). As a result, KB Securities predicts that the average selling price for this specialised memory will increase by between 100 and 150% year-over-year. Bottom line, that will have a knock-on effect on the consumer market too, with a double-digit quarter-over-quarter price increase expected on the other side of the coming new year.

So, while it's one thing for the odd big tech CEO saying " It's impossible for the shortage to last until 2030 ," we do still need to make it to that ballpark year first. Unfortunately for this rapidly overextending metaphor, the field is on fire. If you've been camping out under the bleachers, trying to ignore how hot it's feeling, I recommend taking a look at our freshly updated memory crisis explainer here . Long game made short, yes, it is all AI's fault.

On the flip side for those so inclined, now might be the time to invest in Samsung as KB Securities also predicts "earnings growth virtually guaranteed." The firm predicts Samsung's operating profit to see a 57% year-over-year increase in 2027, reaching 555 trillion Korean won (or a little over $4 billion).

This prediction arrives in the wake of last week's big AI and semiconductor stock sell off . KB Securities note that Samsung saw a share price decline of 19% during this time, which sure ain't nothing!

This hasn't swayed the investment firm's prediction though, with KB Securities saying, "We believe the sell-off is attributable to weaker sentiment [regarding AI investments more broadly] and valuation adjustments amid macro uncertainties, rather than any deterioration in the company’s earnings fundamentals. Macro variables may boost near-term volatility, but are unlikely to affect the direction of earnings growth, given the output reserved by LTAs and rising prices. In short, we believe earnings growth in 2027 is virtually assured."

Well, that investor jargon is all very well and good for a massive corporation like Samsung. For the rest of us, I still don't advise panic buying hardware, but it does look like prices are only going to get worse in the near-term.

items.title: 1.1 亿票之后，哈罗护士终于进入了僵局，特别感谢一位特别敬业的玩家“为她投了 1,000 票”
items.summary: Nurse Harrow voters did, however, prove themselves to be of the most skilled players.

others.title: Art Vision Vol. 06 // Behind The Scenes (Part 1): Dedication and Passion

content.v: Deadlock's most recent round of hero voting amid the City Never Sleeps release has finally come to an end. First we had the one and only Rat King, then Baba, Solomon, Deadman Danny, Violet, and finally, Nurse Harrow, a support with some unorthodox methods.

From the very beginning I've seen some pretty hardcore Nurse Harrow fans, so I was quite surprised to see her take last place, but Valve has revealed that it wasn't actually that close. 110 million votes were cast in total throughout the entire event with just 22,194 players exclusively voting for Nurse Harrow, however, "one player cast exactly 1,000 votes for her", which shows some real dedication.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/6Xif6ynDnq7ZnAKsu32MzK-1920-80.png

But Nurse Harrow fans have something that no one else in Deadlock has: skill. "Nurse Harrow voters consistently proved to have a higher win rate over all other hero voters." Well I didn't vote for Nurse Harrow and they've read me like a book, so that seems pretty accurate I guess.

Other interesting tidbits concerning the City Never Sleeps voting round include how the closest contest was Baba vs Solomon for second place. I personally voted for Solomon but I wasn't too disappointed seeing how Baba has ridiculously good mobility, melee, and can turn enemies into pigeons. I really love that last one.

It also turns out that I am one of the 36,236 players who voted in every round and never once picked that round's winner, not including Nurse Harrow at the end because she was the last option left. What can I say? I'm just not like other Deadlock players. In my defence, though, only 847 players managed to vote in every single round and pick that round's eventual winner, so the number of oracles that play among us is almost next to none.

I have to admit, seeing the voting come to a close leaves me a little melancholic. Community events like this are massively fun and really well orchestrated in Deadlock, and who knows when we'll get another one. Valve likes to work at their own pace so your guess is as good as mine.

items.summary: 近日，日本博主发起投票，征集玩家心中RPG游戏里最没必要、最反人类的设计要素，榜单前五名已经公布，第一名暂时处于悬念状态。

content.v: 由你来说： 近日，日本博主发起投票，征集玩家心中RPG游戏里最没必要、最反人类的设计要素， 你最讨厌RPG游戏里的哪一个系统？
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/21/small_202610211908475070.png
近日，日本博主发起投票，征集玩家心中RPG游戏里最没必要、最反人类的设计要素，榜单前五名已经公布，第一名暂时处于悬念状态。榜单里，武器耐久度以28.4%票数位居第二；错过就无法挽回的不可逆内容排在第三；冗长的文本说明、背包负重限制紧随其后。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/21/small_202610211908579707.png
这份投票很快引发大量玩家讨论，不少玩家各自亮出自己最反感的机制：有人痛恨强制反复刷取的随机掉落；有人反感把关键内容藏进多周目、刻意灌水游戏时长；也有玩家吐槽二游泛滥的自创生僻术语，搭配小字注解看得疲惫；
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/21/small_202610211909014941.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/21/small_202610211909016154.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/21/small_202610211909017445.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/21/small_202610211909029038.png
还有玩家直言负重限制是头号痛点，玩游戏第一件事就是打MOD或者开修改器解除限制。还有一类观点，则是限时、一旦错过就永久消失的内容，不少玩家表示这类设计的讨厌程度远超其余选项。
你最讨厌RPG游戏里的哪一个系统？欢迎在评论区聊聊你的看法。

items.title: “宝可梦”抓宠、战斗、建造海岛！像素新游首曝
items.summary: 抓宠、战斗、建造海岛！《狂战少年》开发商像素新游《Waveling Island》正式公开

content.v: 曾开发《Berserk Boy》《Berserk B.I.T.S》的独立游戏工作室BerserkBoy Games正式公开旗下全新作品《Waveling Island》，并发布首支宣传片。本作是一款融合生物收集、实时战斗、探索与海岛建设的像素风模拟游戏，受到《宝可梦》《集合啦！动物森友会》《数码宝贝》等作品的启发，目前已开放Steam商店页面。
玩家将来到一座风景优美的热带岛屿，从一无所有开始，捕捉、训练超过100种名为“Waveling”的神秘生物，与它们一同探索未知区域、完成任务、收集材料，并逐步将荒芜的沙地建设成理想中的海岛家园。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261021_wjl_646_4/1735.jpg
APP用户【一键加入愿望单】
《 Waveling Island 》宣传片：
在《Waveling Island》中，Waveling会自由活动于岛屿各处。玩家可以直接接近野外生物并发起战斗，无需随机遇敌，也不需要切换至独立的战斗画面。
游戏采用实时战斗系统，玩家最多可以携带5只Waveling组成队伍。每只Waveling最多能够学习8种招式，玩家可以自由调整技能配置，打造适合自己的战斗阵容。
战斗过程中，Waveling会自主行动，而玩家则需要等待频率槽积满，再选择合适的时机下达攻击指令，通过技能与时机把握取得优势。
击败或削弱野生Waveling后，玩家还可以使用捕捉网尝试将其收服。不过，不同生物的捕捉难度各不相同，想要集齐全部伙伴并非易事。
https://imggif.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/21/origin_202610211818036229.gif
游戏中的岛屿包含5个不同的野外区域，每个区域又划分为5个子区域，总计25片可供探索的地点。
不同区域拥有各自独特的Waveling、事件和采集资源。随着玩家不断深入岛屿，还能够获取更高级的制作材料，并遇见更强大、更加稀有的生物。
值得一提的是，Waveling的能力不仅可以用于战斗，也会直接影响地图探索。
例如，遇到挡路的巨石时，可以让格斗型Waveling使用撞击技能将其击碎；面对无法直接跨越的深水区域，则可以借助水属性Waveling的能力前往对岸。
岛屿上还有不少暂时无法抵达的隐藏地点，玩家需要不断收集新的Waveling，利用不同伙伴的能力开辟道路，寻找隐藏的宝藏与稀有生物。
此外，天气与昼夜变化也会影响生物的出现。部分Waveling只会在特定天气或时间段现身，夜晚甚至可能遇见更加危险、稀有的生物。
https://imggif.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/21/origin_202610211818388708.gif
除了收集生物和冒险战斗，《Waveling Island》还加入了丰富的生活模拟与建造内容。
玩家可以带领Waveling前往野外采集资源，返回营地后制作家具、装饰品和各种设施，将最初空荡荡的沙地逐渐改造成属于自己的热带家园。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261021_wjl_646_4/12826.jpg
无论是种植鲜花、建造房屋，还是邀请新的居民来到岛上生活，都可以按照自己的喜好自由安排。
岛上的居民也拥有各自的故事、秘密和任务。通过帮助他们解决烦恼，玩家可以获得独特的装备、装饰品及其他奖励。
如果暂时不想推进主线，也可以放下冒险，享受钓鱼、捕捉蝴蝶或布置家园的悠闲时光。游戏并不要求玩家始终追赶任务进度，而是鼓励按照自己的节奏体验海岛生活。
https://imggif.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/21/origin_202610211819022826.gif
《Waveling Island》并不只有自由探索与生活模拟，还设计了一条完整的主线故事，以及大量支线任务。
玩家将在完成任务的过程中逐步认识岛上的居民，了解他们来到这里的原因，并通过探索解锁新的区域、装备和生物。
与此同时，岛屿似乎还隐藏着某种不为人知的秘密。
每只Waveling都会散发出独特的频率，一种难以听见、却能够切身感受到的振动。而随着玩家不断深入岛屿，这股振动也会变得越来越强烈。
在这片看似宁静的热带天堂深处，究竟隐藏着什么？
https://imggif.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/21/origin_202610211819289012.gif
《Waveling Island》由BerserkBoy Games开发并发行，目前已开放Steam商店页面，具体发售日期尚未公布。
感兴趣的玩家可以前往Steam商店页面关注游戏，了解后续开发进展。

items.title: “我们预计大规模攻击将在发布后 15 分钟内开始”：Web 管理员准备进行紧急 PHP 更新，以堵塞泄漏的高严重性漏洞
items.summary: Batten down the virtual hatches.

others.title: Arbiter of Death - October Update

content.v: The PHP security team has given advanced notice of an upcoming fix for two critical security vulnerabilities, both rated at 9.2 out of 10 on the CVE severity scale.

Info about the flaws seems to have leaked ahead of their official disclosure, as a video is being shared which reportedly shows a tool called PHP2Shell being used to remotely execute code on webservers via the vulnerabilities (via Ars Technica ).

The PHP programming language is widely used across the internet and powers a huge number of websites. The fix is due to be released at 2pm UTC (10 am ET). Researchers from cybersecurity firm Sansec say the vulnerabilities affect all web servers running PHP 5.4 or later, and that "we expect mass attacks to start within 15 minutes of the release."

Dane Knecht, the chief technology officer for Cloudflare, says the company is already updating its firewall rules for PHP sites. "We are seeing early attacks emerging and are updating mitigations as new vectors show up. This is a stopgap only," Knecht posted on X . "Patch as soon as @ThePHPF releases the update at 14:00 UTC today."

Speaking to Bleeping Computer yesterday, the CEO of cybersecurity firm WatchTowr, Benjamin Harris, said: "In the last hour, two remote code execution vulnerabilities in PHP have been leaked. These vulnerabilities were previously scheduled under embargo and due for release on Thursday at 11 am ET."
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/SM8hnsh8PPqNMXUJSPvVmW-1920-80.jpg

"While we are not able to share technical information at this point for obvious reasons, given the sensitivity, we can confirm that these vulnerabilities are indeed real. Both of them are CVSS10 and are understood to affect PHP versions 5, 6, 7, and 8."

It sounds like a pretty anxious time for web administrators around the world right now. The current advice for admins includes taking an inventory of every PHP install, planning a maintenance window to coincide with the update, and making a backup of site and database files in anticipation.

For the rest of us, I guess we're in the hands of the server gods now. 2026 has been a year of increasingly sophisticated security exploits, but this one seems to be on a much larger scale (and of a much higher severity) than most. To quote Samuel L. Jackson in Jurassic Park: Hold on to your butts?

items.title: 触乐怪话：勇闯二手游戏圈
items.summary: 触乐怪话，每天胡侃和游戏有关的屁事、鬼事、新鲜事。 您好，问就是不在！（图/小罗） 我和二手平台的交集正巧始于游戏。Switch发售头一年，我被社交平台和朋友圈里无处不在的红白以及朋友时不时发来的恶魔低语所蛊惑，于是在一

content.v: http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-10-21/6ad87e2c04034.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
触乐怪话，每天胡侃和游戏有关的屁事、鬼事、新鲜事。
我和二手平台的交集正巧始于游戏。Switch发售头一年，我被社交平台和朋友圈里无处不在的红白以及朋友时不时发来的恶魔低语所蛊惑，于是在一个冲动的夜晚，我的手擅自下了单，买下了Switch和“塞尔达”的同捆套餐。
经过几天的翘首以盼，我的快递终于收到了，什么三码合一什么开机红自不必多说，我第一时间打开了“塞尔达”，啊这光影！这杂兵！这割草！但是天下第一的任式引导去哪里了？目之所及皆可往的开放世界又体现在何处？来不及思考了，手忙脚乱忙活了半个小时后，我才意识到，这塞尔达对……对吗？
再三确认订单，我不得不面对我把《塞尔达传说：旷野之息》买成了《塞尔达无双》的事实。当然《塞尔达无双》也是好游戏，可当时的我一心只想着弥补过失，兜兜转转来到了咸鱼，注册了账号，毅然决然把“无双”的卡带挂了上去。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-10-21/8136ad81af9bc8a3.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
以此为契机，我开启了我的二手平台之旅。在此之前，我从来没想过打通关了、不需要了、过时了、出坑了的东西是可以回血的，过去它们的下场一般都是吃灰、借朋友或者进垃圾桶。就像打开了某种开关一样，我开始爱上清理库存，把它们从犄角旮旯里刨出来，包括但不限于游戏卡带、手帐用品、二次元小垃圾、或新或旧的Lolita，简单进行清洁翻新，配上实物图和文案，上架咸鱼，然后下一秒开始幻想被美美直拍，变成温暖的现金。
诚然，买卖二手是件很隐私的事情。吃穿用度、玩的什么游戏、推哪个角色，最近入了什么新坑，主页一看便知。如何在出物的同时做好隐私保护与反侦查，也是不得不品的一环。
几年下来，我也琢磨出了一些有的没的个人经验，说简单也简单，有句话叫“爱人亦是知己”，人总是会欣赏与自己高度相似的人。如果一段人际交往一开始就让我雷达狂响，那说明趁早结束为妙。最终交易愉快的人，往往和自己很类似。
总的来说，我喜欢态度平和、交易不急切、详情页完善的用户，这同时是对我自己的要求。首先，保持平常心很重要。告诉自己我是来出物的，不是来赚钱的，能成交当然好，感谢你带走了我不再需要的游戏，希望你能度过一段同样快乐或受苦的时光。不能成交，那也无妨，下一个会更好。
其次，我会尽我所能地节省双方时间，保障双方体验。当初出《塞尔达无双》的时候我还是纯小白，文案就一行字，“出卡带”，比霸总台词还少。后来，我逐渐学会了如何完善商品详情页，这是踩雷无数后得出的血泪之鉴。
就拿游戏卡带举例吧，文案写清楚购买来源，游玩平台和时长，成色如何，是否带原盒，是否包邮，如遇节假日发货是否会延迟，发货前会录一段插入卡带证明游戏正常运行的视频，贴上“凭完整拆箱视频售后”的封口贴，以及最关键的叠甲“个人闲置不退不换”等。写得越详细，被问细节的可能性就越小，毕竟我已经尽量知无不言了，再明知故问就不礼貌了！
当然，即使我写了事无巨细的详情页，面对“在吗”的问候时，也很难忍住不回一句狗头人的名言。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-10-21/9846ad81d738c02b.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
二手市场真的是个很奇妙的地方。它自由，混乱，无序。在这里，我伪装成一个人类观察综艺的摄像头，默默注视着众生百态，以此为镜。与此同时，我还会收获一些细小的幸福，也许是手帐同好之间的交流，也许是自提时得知对面大哥是个父亲，正要买游戏送孩子。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-10-21/4016ad81b07ef441.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700

content.v: 过去几个月间，裁员潮席卷游戏行业。据ASGC“游戏行业裁员追踪器”估计，在今年，全球超过14500名游戏从业者将会失去工作。这意味着2026年极有可能成为有记录以来，游戏行业裁员现象最严重的年份之一，裁员总数仅次于2024年（15631）。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-10-21/8576ad87fe757f0c.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
除了全职员工之外，游戏行业的运转还离不开无数自由职业者和合同工。他们围绕项目给游戏公司合作，灵活打工，希望能够在维持生计的同时闯出一番名堂。然而，随着市场环境收紧，项目预算不断缩减，这些自由职业者和合同工的机会正变得越来越少。
前不久，笔者与几十位自由作曲家对话，请他们聊了聊近况。
■ 项目随时停摆，工作说没就没
《秘奥：秘宇奥忆》（MIO: Memories in Orbit）是一款画面精美的类银河战士恶魔城游戏，由巴黎工作室Douze Dixièmes开发，今年1月问世。当Kid Katana Records开启《秘奥：秘宇奥忆》原声音乐黑胶唱片的预售时，笔者有幸采访了作曲家尼古拉·吉根（Nicolas Gueguen）。然而，在我收到唱片前，Douze Dixièmes却在6月份突然关停。
“每当一款新游戏发布，我都会做同样的事情：紧盯着Twitch直播，与发现它的首批玩家一起体验。我在那个时刻总是特别紧张。”吉根说，“随着游戏的首批数据出炉，我们非常清楚，《秘奥：秘宇奥忆》不可能像《光与影：33号远征队》那么成功。你甚至可以想象，发行商已经开始咬牙切齿了。”
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-10-21/5426ad880366c03a.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700

据吉根透露，在《秘奥：秘宇奥忆》正式发售前，Douze Dixièmes已经在着手筹备新项目。“我和他们团队开过几次会，收到了所有的设计文档，并且已经开始研究游戏玩法，并搭建了一套简易的交互式音乐系统。”遗憾的是，Douze Dixièmes的法国发行商兼母公司Focus娱乐对其新提案不感兴趣，决定取消该项目。由于手头没有任何其他在研项目，Douze Dixièmes通过与Focus协商重获独立，随后以相对妥善的方式解散团队，并为员工提供了更优厚的离职补偿。“《秘奥：秘宇奥忆》确实没能大获成功，却也算不上彻底失败。然而，发行商缺乏信心和长远眼光，选择了关停工作室。这太可怕了。”
对游戏作曲家来说，就业市场的现状同样令人担忧：参与项目的机会日益减少，寻找机会的人却越来越多。在僧多粥少的环境下，许多初出茅庐的作曲家不得不与业内大佬竞争，甚至为了谋一份差事不惜压低报价。“在游戏行业找活儿干太难了。”吉根感叹，“今年3月，我还在跟三家独立游戏工作室合作，到了4月份，这些工作室居然全都关门了！”
一位不愿公开姓名的资深作曲家补充：“与五年前相比，如今找活儿干确实困难多了。”“游戏工作室普遍变得比过去更谨慎，不愿冒险，争取预算也异常困难。”她说，“我曾经参与或计划参与的几个项目，都因为缺乏资金而遭遇延期、规模缩减，甚至直接被搁置。这种现状给自由作曲家带来了新的变数。某些工作机会看似板上钉钉，却随时有可能因项目、团队的变动而化为泡影。”
“随着众多工作室纷纷关闭，大量顶尖人才正在寻找新工作。”吉根不无担忧地说，“我不得不将目光转向其他行业，并认真考虑转行。”
■ 处境越来越难，“稳定”成了奢望

许多音乐人都有与吉根类似的想法，法国作曲家兼音效设计师罗曼·雷纳尔（Romain Raynal）就是其中之一。雷纳尔从5岁起就开始创作音乐，2021年入行，曾参与Don’t Nod工作室科幻动作冒险游戏《远日点》的制作。但雷纳尔坦言，他很难以“纯粹的作曲家”身份在游戏行业站稳脚跟。因此，与许多同行一样，他又学习和掌握了另一项技能：声音设计。这使雷纳尔的个人能力显得更加全面，也增加了他对独立工作室的吸引力。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-10-21/6146ad880743c1ca.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
“2026年初的情况糟糕透顶，简直就像一场灾难。”雷纳尔回忆，“我不得不想尽办法寻找备选方案。好在进入6月份后，情况稍有好转，如今我的档期已经排满，直到年底都有活儿干……尽管如此，我认为从长远来看，我们仍然很难获得稳定的机会。游戏行业正处于一个转折点：唯有保持灵活应变，我们才能熬过难关。”
另一位不愿透露姓名的作曲家表达了同样的看法。“许多游戏音乐人处境艰难，并且未来充满了不确定性。谁都不知道这场职业危机究竟是暂时的，还是会成为一种新常态。”

《巴别塔圣歌》（Chants of Sennaar）的作曲家托马斯·布吕内（Thomas Brunet）对此深有同感。这款文字解谜冒险游戏自2023年发售以来广受好评，然而，玩家们一直没有机会在其他作品中听到布吕内创作的音乐。“过去几年间，确实有不少团队邀请我加入他们的项目，但真正有望顺利启动的项目却寥寥无几。”他解释，“所有自由职业者都面临着一个难题，那就是围绕项目开展的临时工作缺乏长期稳定性，尤其是在当前阶段。”
布吕内认为，他的近况“比大多数同行稍好一些”，但他完全无法预料自己在2027年初将会面临怎样的局面。不过，《巴别塔圣歌》研发工作室Rundisc已经宣布，布吕内将负责团队下一款游戏的配乐工作。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-10-21/5626ad880972aea8.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
在2026年世界电影原声协会（World Soundtrack Awards）颁奖典礼上，《克苏鲁：恐怖深渊》（Cthulhu: The Cosmic Abyss）力压《UNDERTABLE》和《红色沙漠》，赢得了年度游戏音乐奖。然而9月初，在《克苏鲁：恐怖深渊》发售短短5个月后，研发工作室Big Bad Wolf就进入了破产清算程序。
《克苏鲁：恐怖深渊》的作曲家尼古拉·加西亚（Nicolas Garcia）承认，他之前就听说了发行商Nacon打算关闭Big Bad Wolf的传闻。“当工作室被关闭的消息传出时，我并没有太惊讶，但确实非常失望。游戏团队原本计划推出一部续作，我甚至已经想好邀请哪几位音乐家参与项目……我尤其同情那些突然失去工作的开发者，并愿意全力支持他们。”
加西亚补充，《克苏鲁：恐怖深渊》拿到WSA“年度游戏音乐奖”令他百感交集。“我希望向让这款游戏变成现实的所有人致敬，这是我能想到的最佳致敬方式。”作为一位高产作曲家，加西亚还可以依靠在其他行业的工作来维持生计。不过，按照加西亚的说法，其他行业的就业形势同样严峻。“从目前情况来看，2027年我的工作将会覆盖游戏、电视剧集和电影等领域。我无意抱怨，但我确实觉得，那些行业的整体氛围也特别紧张。”
■ 一边向外展示，一边苦练内功
与此同时，游戏作曲家还应积极拓展人脉，并维持在社交媒体上的曝光度。考虑到游戏行业的现状，这似乎比以往任何时候都更加重要。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-10-21/6056ad880d92d8f9.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
2025年9月，凭借科幻射击游戏《合金天使：堕入伊甸》（Metal Eden）中令人着迷的音乐，作曲家兼音效总监VOLA Default在游戏业内崭露头角。自从《合金天使：堕入伊甸》发售、游戏的原声带登陆流媒体平台以来，她便不断尝试以各种方式在网上展现自己，包括详细拆解创作音乐的过程，分享幕后故事等。此外，她甚至将部分作品带到夜总会现场表演，努力让音乐突破游戏的边界，吸引更多人关注。
经过几个月的努力，VOLA Default终于收获了回报，收到邀约为一款新游戏作曲。不过，由于与游戏团队签有保密协议，她暂时还不能透露具体细节。
英国作曲家Alpha Chrome Yayo也建议同行在社交平台频繁发帖，分享工作中的趣事，并全方位地展示自身才华。他认为，在算法驱动的数字空间，这些做法能够帮助游戏作曲家提升影响力。作为《Promise Mascot Agency》首席作曲家，他每天都会在Instagram上发布短视频，带玩家了解创作游戏音乐的幕后过程，或者使用自己收藏的大量乐器和模拟设备进行即兴演奏。
谈及对游戏作曲家就业形势的看法，Alpha承认：“从整个行业层面来看，大家的工作稳定性和士气确实已经跌至低谷。”但他并没有心灰意冷。“我从小喜欢游戏，如今更为每天都能看到令人惊叹的游戏问世感到格外振奋。考虑到许多工作室处境艰难，它们的诞生简直就像奇迹，是开发者才华与坚韧的结晶。”Alpha说，“通过打造众多精彩作品，开发者们扇了那些滥竽充数、助纣为虐之徒一记响亮的耳光。”
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-10-21/3606ad880fd1a826.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700

这位现居贝尔法斯特的作曲家正在参与多个新项目，其中包括《洛基》（Röki）、《Mythwrecked》研发工作室Polygon Treehouse即将推出的新作。他还称赞了游戏开发者互帮互助的氛围，并认为同行彼此间的支持远比竞争更有意义。“团结的力量非常强大。例如，北美游戏行业工会设立的‘游戏从业者困难援助基金’（Game Hardship Fund），以及Itch平台的游戏捆绑包促销活动，都为开发者带来了巨大帮助，呈现了游戏行业最美好的一面。”

但Alpha指出，在当今游戏行业，“纯粹的作曲家”很难获得新的工作机会。与VOLA Default的观点类似，他认为游戏作曲家应当通过掌握声音设计、音频整合等技能来拓展能力范围，从而增加对小团队的吸引力。“许多小型团队人手有限，预算十分紧张，自然希望你能身兼多项技能。”他解释，“与此同时，无论你身处何地，或者正在从事什么工作，这些技能都很有价值。另外，声音设计真的很有趣！这就像解答一道道谜题，你需要思考许多问题，包括如何从零开始构建声音、怎样做才能最契合游戏的需求，为玩家提供最佳体验？”
另一位不愿透露姓名的女作曲家深有同感。“近段时间我专注于声音设计和配音指导，目的是不断拓展技能树，提升个人竞争力。我希望有朝一日成为音频总监，所以想在这方面积累更多实战经验。当我选择参与哪些项目时，我就是抱着这种想法。”她觉得自己非常幸运，目前正在参与数个长期项目，暂时不用为生计发愁。尽管如此，她仍然对游戏行业的严峻形势感到忧虑：“过去几年间，我们这一行遭受了极其沉重的打击。”
■ 危机可能变成转机，永远不要轻易放弃

如果周围的人纷纷溺水，而你仍然能把头伸出水面，你可能会产生一种幸存者内疚感。谈及自己仍有机会收到游戏工作室合作邀约的近况时，温馨朋克风格叙事模拟游戏《我看人下碟》（Wax Heads）作曲家吉娜·洛伊林（Gina Loughlin）并没有骄傲，语气中甚至带有几分歉意。“我感到有些内疚，因为我身边有那么多人处境艰难，我的日子却过得还不错。”她说，“许多朋友和同事正在承受大规模裁员潮的冲击，但不知道为什么，我这边一切还好。”
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-10-21/7476ad8813f10e4b.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
从某种意义上讲，这位英国资深作曲家受到了冒名顶替综合征的困扰。不过，她并非故作谦虚，而是发自内心地同情工作朝不保夕的众多同行，尤其是那些正试图进入游戏行业的新人。“每当某个项目接近尾声时，我都会担心这是否意味着我的职业生涯即将终结，接下来不得不回到地狱般的零售业……我为刚刚入行的新人，为那些失去工作的朋友，以及连续几个月甚至几年没有找到新机会的同事们感到忧虑。”

在游戏行业，突如其来的裁员往往令很多人措手不及，职业规划被彻底打乱，并陷入极度恐慌之中。西班牙作曲家费尔南多·卡布雷拉（Fernando Cabrera）为《极乐迪斯科》开发商ZA/UM的新作《归零巡礼：亡谍镇魂曲》创作了原声音乐，然而在今年7月，ZA/UM突然宣布裁撤整支音频团队，并解雇了包括资深音频设计师、游戏中多首歌曲的演唱者米雷拉·迪兹（Mirella Die）在内的32名员工。随着《归零巡礼：亡谍镇魂曲》的后续音乐制作计划被取消，卡布雷拉失去了一次不错的工作机会。

“我还没有接到新活儿，至少短期内是不太可能了。我明白，夏季并非作曲家找活儿干的理想时机，因为大家都在休假，你很难让潜在合作方回复业务洽谈邮件。但我必须承认，我们这一行目前的整体形势确实不容乐观。”卡布雷拉认为，那些手握大权的高管正在将整个行业推向绝境。“高管们太贪得无厌，制定了根本无法实现的目标，严重低估了创意链条上每个环节的价值。”他说，“开发者和玩家不再被视为需要用心照顾的对象……在游戏音频和音乐领域，这种现象尤为明显，某些项目负责人和总监仍然轻视我们的专业技能。”
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-10-21/7606ad8815fe718b.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
卡布雷拉以积极乐观的心态看待未来。卡布雷拉表示，虽然他对电视、动画或电影领域的合作机会持开放态度，但始终最喜欢为游戏创作音乐。他相信，尽管当前形势严峻，许多游戏作曲家的职业生涯将会迎来转机。

今年7月，由于单人动作角色扮演游戏《Edge of Memories》的法国研发工作室Midgar Studio突然被母公司Nacon关闭，歌手玛丽昂（Marion，艺名Mioune，此前曾在类宝可梦游戏《Temtem》中献声）为该项目所做的工作被叫停。尽管如此，玛丽昂觉得自己很幸运，因为她正与几家完全独立的工作室合作——这些工作室依靠自有资金，或者通过众筹来维持运营。另外，与她长期合作的作曲家塞德里克·门伦德斯（Cédric Menendez）创办了自己的音乐制作公司，俩人未来很可能会继续合作。
玛丽昂为《Edge of Memories》付出的心血也不会白费。法国发行商Nacon证实，虽然Midgar已经关停，这款游戏仍将在2026年内发售。“或许这能为我带来一些新机会。”
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-10-21/2056ad881826ecbc.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
与此同时，游戏作曲家普遍感受到了行业近况不佳引发的连锁效应。多位受访者表示，游戏工作室愿意提供的报酬大幅降低，或者在合同中要求他们接受某些特定的支付条款。为了维持生计，许多作曲家别无选择，只能做出让步。吉娜·洛伊林说：“最近我留意到，很多团队带着短期项目找我谈合作，那些项目量级小、预算少，交付周期也更短。”
这似乎是工作室为了提升自身对发行商的吸引力，争取潜在资金支持所采取的举措。“道理我都懂，但这确实给工作室的财务状况带来了显著影响。”洛伊林解释，“为了让项目更受发行商青睐，所有环节的预算都被压缩了……因此，有时我不得不接受报酬低于理想水平的工作，或者签署条款未必让我满意的合同。”
另一位不愿公开姓名的作曲家补充：“我也遇到过那种情况。在当时，我同意收取较低报酬，但作为交换条件，我要求合作方将游戏音乐在流媒体平台上净收入的50%，以及原声带直接销售收入的50%分给我。”尼古拉·加西亚表达了类似的看法。“总的来说，我觉得游戏工作室为作曲家提供的报酬确实呈下降趋势，但这并不会阻碍我继续为游戏创作音乐。在可以接受的合理范围内，我会根据项目预算调整对报酬的心理预期。”
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-10-21/7156ad881a412508.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
近年来，3A游戏大厂已经很少长期聘用内部作曲家：当EA、育碧和索尼等业内巨头打造旗舰游戏时，往往会选择与好莱坞知名作曲家合作，而微软则习惯于将此类工作外包给Finishing Move之类的专业音乐制作公司……对许多自由职业者来说，在游戏公司谋求一份全职工作，或许已经不再是终极目标。
某种意义而言，从事自由职业并非一种负担，反倒更像一项宝贵的资产——它所带来的灵活性，恰恰与游戏音乐极其丰富的多样性完美契合。在新品不断涌现的游戏行业，独立作曲家永远不会缺少合适的机会。

另一方面，虽然部分游戏工作室投机取巧，选择用AI创作音乐，但仍大量独立工作室坚决抵制生成式AI技术。许多工作室在与作曲家或音效设计师合作时，甚至会在合同中明确加入这项条款。Alpha说，他很庆幸自己有机会与那些高度重视原创的游戏团队合作。“在项目目标和创作理念方面，每位创作者都达成了共识。”他透露，“过去一年间，我签署的几乎每份合同都包含一条内容大致如下的条款：‘本项目中，任何一方均不得使用生成式人AI。’每当我看到这句话，我都感到无比高兴！”
本文编译自： N owplaying
原文标题：《How Indie Game Composers Are Surviving the Layoff Storm》
原作者： Peterline6

items.title: 提前玩上《GTA6》了？《使命召唤》新作藏GTA彩蛋
items.summary: 《使命召唤：现代战争4》发售后，玩家在战役模式的一处游戏内屏幕上发现了疑似《GTA》系列的彩蛋

content.v: 近日日本游戏开发者@AlphaNutsGames在社交媒体发文称，自己耗时约9年开发的游戏《Deserter's》遭到破解，不仅被翻译成中文，游戏内容也被擅自修改，甚至连Bug都被修复。对此，开发者深感失望，并表示正在考虑彻底退出中国市场相关业务。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261021/1792556405_703560_jpg_r.jpg
开发者在原文中写道：“制作工作暂时停滞了。被中国社区搞了……《Deserter's》被破解了，不仅是翻译，连游戏内容都被修改了，甚至还好心地帮忙修复了Bug。“
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261021/1792556405_533610.png
“此前，我正在与合作公司协商Steam版本的相关事宜，原计划也包括中文支持。但作为一门生意，这件事已经没法继续了吧……追加内容原本也计划支持中文，现在也只能搁置了。”
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261021/1792556405_771435.png
如果只是非法上传，倒还可以接受，但擅自修改游戏内容实在无法容忍。我正在考虑彻底退出面向中国市场的相关业务。”
据了解，《Deserter's》发布在日本同人数字内容销售平台DLsite，开发者表示，该作耗时约9年完成，采用原创引擎，并包含手绘原画、Live2D动画及大量文本内容。
面对游戏遭破解并被擅自修改的情况，开发者随后还分享了自己的真实感受。他表示自己并没有特别愤怒，更多的是一种难以言说的无力感。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261021/1792556405_638169.png
他接着写道：“素不相识的中国人，擅自把我花了9年制作的游戏翻译后免费传播，还说着‘请尽情享受吧’，仿佛那是他们自己创作的作品一样。那一刻，我感觉自己就像是在旁观另一个世界发生的事情。”
尽管遭遇了这次打击，开发者并未表示会彻底停止游戏开发。他透露，后续追加内容仍会继续制作，但中文支持计划可能就此取消，未来或许只会推出日语版本。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

items.title: Chinese repair centre has received 7 melted 12+4-pin Nvidia GPUs in just the past two days alone
items.summary: This is not getting better, is it?

content.v: YouTube channel, 修电脑的张哥 , roughly translated to Zhang the Computer Repairman, has posted a video this morning because of the sheer volume of Nvidia GPUs they have had sent in for repair in just the past two days alone. And they're all because of burnt interfaces between the 12+4-pin power cable and the card itself.

Seven cards in total have come in for repair (via Uniko's Hardware ), mostly RTX 5090 cards, along with Asus and MSI RTX 4090. They all come from various manufacturers; as well as Asus and MSI there is also a Gainward card in the mix as well as a Founders Edition RTX 5090 , too.

You can see in the video that either the socket interface is burned, sometimes blackening the PCB, or the 12+4-pin power connector itself has melted into the socket and the user has had to snip the cable off in order to be able to send the card in for testing.

Zhang makes the necessary repairs to each of the cards—removing the interface, cleaning the contacts, and soldering on a new 12+4-pin socket—and then goes ahead and tests each one of them. With the new sockets in place, the repaired cards are back in action and while the GPUs run through some 3DMark benchmarks he checks the temperatures on the cards and the cables.
Some still run a little hot, with the cables at the PSU also running pretty toasty, but nothing particularly worrying at this point.

But still the fact remains that this is a really high volume of cards coming into a single repairshop, all presenting the same symptoms and all from different manufacturers, too. He does also note the users are not necessarily running weak PSUs, and some are even from lab computers (though these might also get hammered more than a card someone is using to game on at home).

It might be that it's a very popular repair channel on BiliBili and YouTube, so potentially he might get sent more than other shops, but it's obvsiously still an issue. It feels like, on a long enough timeline, a whole lot of RTX graphics cards using a 12+4-pin connector are going to suffer from this problem.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/W9TdG6zxtKuH3Rr7ZaMHCk-1920-80.jpg

One thing Zhang does note is that during use, if you touch the back of your finger against the power cable, maybe an inch or so above the GPU connector, you should feel it being a little warm. But if it's notably too hot to touch then there's likely an issue.

Likewise he suggests keeping an eye on the power draw via GPU-Z, and particularly the 12+4-pin voltage readout. With failing cards, he notes that if the 12+4-pin voltage drops well below 12 V—to 11.3 or 11.4—then there is likely an issue and you should check the temperature by hand at that point.

What's clear though is this issue isn't going away, isn't purely down to dodgy vendor adaptors or old PSUs, or even miss-aligned cables. The amount of power being drawn by these beefy cards is melting cables and connectors, and if you have one of these GPUs it's worth monitoring it on the regular.

That said, if you want a little more peace of mind, there are new gadgets that can offer some. If not complete protection, then some forewarning of an issue before it becomes a melty mess. Such as this new OCP dongle from Super Flower .

items.title: Here's another gizmo to prevent your graphics card from melting - wouldn't it be nice if 12+4-pin connectors weren't a cause for concern at all?
items.summary: I'm thankful for accessories like this, but I wish it wasn't my problem to sort in the first place.

content.v: Power supply manufacturer Super Flower has launched a new accessory that sits between a graphics card and its power cable to ensure neither ends up a hot, expensive mess as too many Nvidia cards seem to be .

It's called the VGA 12+4 pin OCP Dongle . It's a big lump of plastic and ARGB LEDs that measures for high current across the power pins that make up the 12V-2x6 (or 12VHPWR) connector. This connector is capable of delivering up to 600 watts—enough for an RTX 5090 —but it's overcurrent (a current that exceeds the cable/connectors ratings) that could cause a catastrophic failure.

There are really six 'hot' +12V pins on the connector. That means each of those pins needs to carry around 8.33333 amps or thereabouts. That power load doesn't stay perfectly balanced between the pins, due to resistance and imperfections, which means some pins get less amps, while some get more amps. It's when they get a lot more amps that things start to get melty.
Super Flower's OCP Dongle keeps a close watch on those amps, and will indicate when any pin exceeds 9.5 A.
If any one pins is between 9.5 - 12 A, the dongle will light up orange and emit an intermittent buzzing sound.

If any one pin exceeds 12 A, the dongle will light up red and emit a continuous buzzing sound. If this continues for 195 seconds, VGA Black Screen Protection is triggered, which tries to buy you some time to check your connections.

It's a pretty neat solution and one that's not entirely new to me, as I've got something very similar in my own PC: Cooler Master's GPU Shield Adapter Cable . It operates on more or less the same principle, with lights and buzzers to let you know if it's all going to hell in a handbasket.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/LFokfLTuHmgER8iajPQJmM-1920-80.jpg

That might be a more reliable choice right now, as Uniko's Hardware , who spotted this Super Flower dongle, suggests it is only available in Taiwan right now, included in a bundle with a power supply. There are power supplies that offer similar features, too, such as those with MSI's 'GPU Safeguard+' .
Though why I have to deal with this gnawing worry about my expensive graphics card is another thing entirely. Surely it doesn't have to be this way?

items.title: 粉丝们对《怪物史莱克 2 重制版》令人惊讶的 PC 要求做出反应
items.summary: Shrek 2 isn’t exactly pushing the bounds of PC graphics, but the recommended specs for the remaster are surpri

others.title: Surprise! Aspyr Is Remastering A Shrek Game

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/21/shrek-2-remasterd-screenshot-farfaraway-1792575980552.jpg

Shrek 2 isn’t exactly pushing the bounds of PC graphics, but the recommended specs for the remaster are surprisingly hefty. Originally released in 2004, this remaster boasts better textures, enhanced UI, 4K resolution — and, it seems, a beefy PC.

According to the Steam page , to even run Shrek 2 Remastered you’ll need a GeForce RTX 4060 or RTX 3060 Ti graphics card or equivalent. The developer recommends a GeForce RTX 4070 or RTX 5070 to get the best experience. What have they been feeding him? Have a look at the screenshots in the slideshow, below, to get a sense of what to expect.

“Those swamp graphics better be baller,” said one X / Twitter user . Another complained that they’re able to run Red Dead Redemption 2 at the highest settings, but their PC would apparently struggle with this makeover of a 22-year-old game.

“Seems a bit much for a remaster of a GameCube game but if that’s what we need to render Shrek’s highly detailed green skin then so be it,” said another Twitter user . “They went full in with the GTA 6 aesthetics,” said another .

Other posts expressed concern over it being a “vibe coded” remaster, but there’s currently no AI disclosure on Steam to suggest that’s the case. Valve asked developers to specify when they use AI during game creation or marketing.

Shrek 2 Remastered was revealed alongside a trailer that parodied GTA 6 , and is set to launch just over a week before Rockstar’s behemoth, on November 10. Despite the parody trailer, no one expected it to have similar graphical demands as GTA 6, but here we are. You’ll need 12-16GB of VRAM for this beast. It’s a bit ogre the top.

The remaster is developed by port specialist Aspyr, the studio behind Lord of the Rings: War in the North — Legacy Edition , Deus Ex: Remastered , Tomb Raider 1-3 Remastered , and the disastrous Star Wars: Battlefront Classic Collection .

本作将密室逃脱玩法与合作恐怖体验相结合，需要 4 名玩家共同组成调查小队，进入一栋与十年前火灾案相关的废弃老楼，在童谣与阴影交织的空间中，玩家需分工调查、交换线索、合作破解谜题，逐步揭开一场被掩埋多年的秘密。

在分销平台购买多人包，同样可享额外 85 折优惠，首发折扣叠加后，单份仅需 32.64 元。
游戏简介
《捉迷藏》是一款支持四人联机的中式恐怖游戏。玩家将分别扮演记者、前警察、志愿者与小职员，围绕一场火灾案展开调查。
一场看似普通的火灾案，却揭开了小城尘封十年的悬案序幕，也将四位主角的命运捆绑进诡谲的迷局。他们既是火灾案的调查者，也是悲剧的亲临者，更是十年前案件的亲历者。
葬身火海的孤儿，失踪男孩的现身，反复响起的儿歌……当监控录像拍下纵火者的瞬间，他们才发现，要揭开的远不止一场火灾。在这场捉迷藏中，有人藏真相，有人躲自己。
游戏特色
l 三重视角，双线叙事：
游戏以调查者、亲临者、亲历者三重视角展开，在灰烬与残骸中探寻真相;双线叙事缝合十年前后的罪恶拼图，每一次发现都指向更深的秘密。
l 一场火灾，四段记忆：
四名角色的行动逻辑，都严格贴合其人物背景与职业。通过场景内的交互道具、使用 道具、完成解谜，逐步拼凑出自己背后隐藏的故事碎片。

l 分工协作：
随着剧情推进，玩家将经历不同阶段的组队、交流与配合。当需要独自行动时，队友提供的线索可能成为破局关键;当全员集结时，道具是否交换、线索是否共享，选择权在你手中。而当危险降临时，队友的陪伴与救助，将成为这场惊心动魄的游戏里最真实的安全感。

探索期间，两名玩家可能被机关分隔，无法直接看到对方所处的环境。双方只能通过手中的对讲机描述线索、核对信息，共同破解挡路的谜题。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261021/1792576116_576849_jpg_r.jpg
本作将舞台设在南极大陆。两名角色为营救伙伴来到当地，却意外受困于冰层下方，随后进入一座遍布可疑机械的研究设施。该设施由凯瑟琳·鲍掌控，她的团队曾距离完成一项研究仅差一步，却在中途集体消失。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261021/1792576117_689352_jpg_r.jpg
玩家需要接手团队未完成的研究，并在深入设施时逐步接触隐藏其中的阴谋。Steam目前提供首发九折优惠。

近日，《最终幻想：共鸣》评分正式出炉，GameSpot为本作打出了7分的评价，不少玩家看到分数偏低，认为媒体评分并不合理。

https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/21/small_202610211741018828.png

items.title: 越狱竞赛在 GTA 6 发布前夕升温，索尼发布 PS5 新固件更新
items.summary: Sony has issued a new PlayStation 5 firmware update amid the homebrew community's ongoing effort to jailbreak

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2025/02/26/ps5console-1740609475402.jpeg
Sony has issued a new PlayStation 5 firmware update amid the homebrew community's ongoing effort to jailbreak the console.

PS5 system software update 26.07-14.20.00 is available now and weighs in at 1.2 GB. While Sony’s official patch notes suggest its only function is to improve “the messages and usability on some screens,” some believe it may perform other functions under the hood.
PS5 firmware update 26.07-14.20.00 patch notes:

The PlayStation homebrew scene hit the headlines in recent weeks for releasing PS5 jailbreaks for prior firmwares. For example, late last month, a jailbreak that supported all PS5 consoles running firmware 7.00-13.60 sent shockwaves through the homebrew community. At the time, it meant that all PS5s, including the PS5 Pro, that hadn't been updated within the previous week, were compatible with the jailbreak.

This is of huge significance for Sony and the security of the PS5, as people with a jailbroken PS5 can modify their console, potentially opening the door to video game piracy. However, it was found that some PS5 games subsequently required the latest 14.00 firmware in order to download updates, sparking a renewed effort to release a new jailbreak for the updated system software.

So, there is a game of Whac-A-Mole at play where the homebrew scene is working to release a new jailbreak for the latest PS5 firmware, then do it all over again when Sony releases a new firmware update designed to beef up security. It’s worth pointing out that Sony makes no mention of security in today’s patch notes.

This in turn has sparked concern that if a PS5 jailbreak is made available for the firmware that is required by GTA 6, which comes out in less than a month, then it may be possible for Rockstar’s game to be pirated on PS5 and maybe even made available on PC.

One prominent member of the PlayStation homebrew community recently showed evidence of a jailbreak for the 14.10 firmware, but follow up comments suggest that dumping game executables isn't possible. There is no evidence to suggest that today’s 14.20 update is a response to that. However, some believe GTA 6 will require at least 14.20 to run, now it’s out in the wild. Sony may even release a further security update before November 19.

The question for Sony is whether it can do enough to eventually win this game of Whac-A-Mole with the homebrew scene. This is something of an existential crisis for Sony, which publishers and developers rely upon for the security of their PlayStation releases. But with the emergence of powerful AI models, the stakes have risen significantly.

items.title: 《疯狂水世界》一天能赚29万！怪不得有钱打广告

content.v: 前排强调，这并不是疯狂水世界的广告，大家可以放心食用。
快问快答，开局要选什么？
选尿液过滤器，还是黄金马桶？
怎么样才能住进高级庇护所？
如果这几句话你都能接上， 恭喜，你已经被迫修完了《 疯狂水世界 》2026 年义务教育 。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/21/origin_4630187_7012691.jpg
这几个月，只要你生活在中文互联网，就一定被下面这些广告轰炸过。
一个穿着破汗衫的中年光头，生活在末世的海上庇护所里。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/21/origin_4630187_7012686.jpg
住的是最烂的房型，所有人都能压他一头，过得比《 回家的诱惑 》的林品如还憋屈，《 花少 2 》的井柏然还狼狈。
每次刷到他，要么是广场舞大妈在他楼上跳舞，楼下的人在烧水蒸桑拿，隔壁又把空调外机装他房间里。
https://imggifb.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/21/origin_4630187_7012700.gif
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/21/origin_4630187_7012687.jpg
出门在外也被人看不起。打车不让坐、吃饭不让吃、洗澡没有水，别人开游艇，他只能划澡盆，永远比别人矮一截。
https://imggifb.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/21/origin_4630187_7012705.gif
他每天被雨淋，被人笑的终极原因，只是因为他没能开出——
海水过滤器。
最后，被虐到不行的肥强，终于暴起，咬牙发誓，必须要捞到自己的海水过滤器，住进高级庇护所。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/21/origin_4630187_7012688.jpg
一拳打破白墙，跳进红色澡盆里，高喊着“ 疯狂水世界，启动！”划走了。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/21/origin_4630187_7012695.jpg
广告到这，一般就会莫名其妙地结束了。
虽然往往只有几十秒，但却异常洗脑，每次刷到都会被狠狠硬控。一边骂自己有病，一边又忍不住看完。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/21/origin_4630187_7012690.jpg
而这些都是《 疯狂水世界 》这个游戏投放的广告。
游戏本身是个SLG末日建造游戏，但广告的永远都是这个叫阿强的肥宅和好友阿水，在末世庇护所里四处碰壁。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/21/origin_4630187_7012692.jpg
最后，冲着屏幕喊出那句：“三十年河西三十年河东，我这就去打捞海水过滤器，三分钟一局，巨爽巨解压 ”。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/21/origin_4630187_7012697.jpg
而和它同类型的广告，也都做到了成功洗脑，包括但不限于：
你是什么鸭？ 我玩的是狙击鸭。 原来是 5 大神，快请进快请进。
你是什么鸭？ 我玩的是倒霉鸭。 原来是只会躲在背后放诅咒的废物，快给我滚。
https://imggifb.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/21/origin_4630187_7012710.gif
师傅师傅救一下。 说一个救你的理由。 我灵画师走出新手村了。
哎呀侄儿受苦了... 但我出新手村的死了一次。杀一只怪才涨一点攻击力，死一次全部清零，灵画师再来一局！
https://imggifb.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/21/origin_4630187_7012707.gif
知识都学杂了，世超现在每天脑子里就来回播报：开局要选狙击鸭，三分钟一局，灵画师启动！
真金白银的数字，更是证明了这一系列广告的成功。
《 疯狂水世界 》非常火，并且赚钱。
今年 3 月，它登顶了抖音小游戏畅销榜第一，后面也一直在各平台小游戏畅销榜 2-5 位来回徘徊。最近还上线了海外版，依然成绩出色，基本就是最赚钱的那档。
根据七麦数据的统计，近一年光是 iOS 端就赚了 1601 万美刀。换算过来 1 亿多人民币，平均每天要赚 29 万。
而且，和一般的买量广告不同的是，真的有一大批网友，真情实感地追更。
网友给它打上了 #国漫 、 #追番 的 tag，广告素材一更新，就立马奔走相告：你最爱看的国漫更新了、小胖什么时候才能翻身。
在新的一集里，小胖终于打捞到了海水过滤器，要过上人上人的生活。
那一条视频，在抖音上有 18w 的点赞。 无数人喊着“ 爷青结 ”、“ 我的夏天结束了 ”。大家不是玩抽象，是真爱看。
甚至阿强和阿水的短剧都呈上来了，官方烹饪了足足 50 集。
连一个撞脸阿强的素人博主，都已经靠着这个，攒了几千粉丝了。
这大概已经算买量广告的最高境界了。
看到这，你不难发现，这早就不是传统买量广告的玩法了。
《 疯狂水世界 》这类广告，算是彻底打响了买量广告界的莱克星顿枪声。
从此之后， AI 广告才是买量界的正统。 前两天，我们的游戏行业群里还有人在求会做水世界 AI 广告的人才。
大人，时代已经变了。
做买量广告多年的狸狸和世超说，现在他们公司招人， 不会用 AI 的压根不要。 曾经那些能手搓精美 CG 的老员工，钻研的不再是什么 UE5、Maya，全扎堆去进修 AI 了。
你会用AI，你就好找工作。你的团队会用 AI，你的卖价就更高。
现在广告业，就这么个情况。
狸狸公司的广告里，基本有一半以上的素材，都是 AI 生成的。
AI的业绩被写进了他们的OKR和日报里。用了多少 AI 素材、跑了多少 token，全部都要列出来。
她们公司甚至专门搭了好几个 AI 平台，专门用来跑素材。
而听完狸狸搓广告的流程，世超也理解了这行为啥被渗透得那么彻底。
成本低、速度快、效率高。

items.title: 红果短剧宣布下线金币功能 12月底前对所有用户关闭
items.summary: 10月21日，红果短剧官方发布《关于红果短剧计划下线金币功能的公告》，宣布将分阶段下线金币功能，预计2026年12月底前面向所有用户…

content.v: 10月21日，红果短剧官方发布《关于红果短剧计划下线金币功能的公告》，宣布将分阶段下线金币功能，预计2026年12月底前面向所有用户全面下线。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/21/small_202610211730274274.jpg
根据公告，自2026年11月1日起，当天及之后新激活的用户将不再获得金币功能及相关入口。此前已经使用金币功能的用户暂不受影响，仍可继续正常使用。
红果短剧计划于2026年12月31日前，面向所有用户下线金币功能，并停止发放金币，具体调整安排将通过后续公告另行通知。
针对用户已经获得的金币和现金余额，红果短剧表示，相关权益不受此次功能调整影响。在金币功能调整前，平台将通过相关页面通知等方式持续提醒用户，并预留充足的金币兑换和现金提现时间。
红果短剧提醒，金币功能的具体截止时间及相关安排，请以官方后续公告和App内通知为准，如有疑问，用户可联系红果短剧App客服。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/21/small_202610211730279003.jpg

items.title: 《乱斗骑士》10月27日开启抢先体验并转向合作PvE
items.summary: Funktronic Labs宣布，动作RPG《乱斗骑士》将于2026年10月27日在PC和Xbox Series X|S开启抢先体验。PC版将通过Steam和Microsoft Store推出，并支持Game Pass

content.v: Funktronic Labs宣布，动作RPG《乱斗骑士》将于2026年10月27日在PC和Xbox Series X|S开启抢先体验。PC版将通过Steam和Microsoft Store推出，并支持Game Pass；Steam目前已有免费试玩版。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261021/1792575035_108481.jpg
这款游戏在2025年首次公布时采用32人大逃杀玩法，随后大幅调整开发方向并更名，改为以 合作 PvE为核心的轻量在线冒险。开发团队表示，游戏受到《塞尔达传说》启发，玩家将扮演见习骑士，在特拉科特王国展开探索。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261021/1792575036_325625.jpg
冒险区域包括岛屿和地下城，玩家需要解开谜题、击败怪物并寻找稀有战利品，随后返回据点锻造装备、承接新任务。在线世界最多可由32人共享，但具体冒险既可单人完成，也能组成最多四人的队伍。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261021/1792575037_585038.jpg
城镇广场提供钓鱼、强化装备和招募伙伴等功能，旅途中还可能因争夺资源与其他骑士队伍发生PvP冲突。游戏另有在线分屏合作计划，但测试版暂不提供该功能；角色死亡后会变成鸡，并以旁观状态继续观看队友行动。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

items.title: 消息称私募机构曾评估收购Xbox！估值达1000亿至1500亿美元

content.v: 一批身份未公开的私募股权机构据称曾研究收购Xbox，并将该业务估值定在1000亿至1500亿美元。不过，这项设想很快被放弃，没有推进到与Xbox或微软展开谈判的阶段。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261021/1792574842_597151_jpg_r.jpg
现有消息没有说明这次评估发生的时间，也未披露相关机构的名称。所谓接近1000亿美元的“报价”并非已经递交的正式收购要约，更准确地说，这是潜在买家对交易规模进行的内部测算。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261021/1792574843_435034_jpg_r.jpg
Xbox负责人Asha Sharma已经明确表示Xbox不出售。目前也没有材料表明微软曾主动寻求出售Xbox、收到正式报价，或与任何潜在买方进行接洽。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261021/1792574847_528358_jpg_r.jpg
作为规模参照，微软在2022年以687亿美元收购动视暴雪，该资产也被视为Xbox整体估值的重要组成部分。若1000亿至1500亿美元的交易真正发生，其规模将明显超过现有游戏行业并购纪录，但相关设想目前仅停留在评估阶段。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

items.title: 《超级马力欧64》石碑计算分析找到新的文字候选！
items.summary: 《超级马力欧64》桃花公主城堡喷泉上的模糊石碑出现了新的文字候选。程序员Mochi64通过计算分析认为，两行文字最接近“Eternal Star”和“We Hope So”，而非流传约30年的“L is Real 240

content.v: 《超级马力欧64》桃花公主城堡喷泉上的模糊石碑出现了新的文字候选。程序员Mochi64通过计算分析认为，两行文字最接近“Eternal Star”和“We Hope So”，而非流传约30年的“L is Real 2401”。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261021/1792574607_771211_jpg_r.jpg
这块石碑长期与路易吉可解锁、数字暗藏线索等猜想联系在一起。Mochi64没有单纯放大图片，而是反推20世纪90年代美术人员可能采用的词语、字体和缩放方式，再将生成的像素与游戏原始纹理进行比较。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261021/1792574609_672979_jpg_r.jpg
石碑原始文字位于一块32×32像素纹理中，两行字符实际仅有3至5像素高，普通放大无法还原缺失的细节，肉眼辨认也容易受到主观预期影响。Mochi64公开了分析代码，并测试了超过120万个词及数百万种组合。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261016/1792095209_460434.jpg
其方法以像素不匹配程度为候选结果评分，分数越低就越接近原图。“Eternal Star / We Hope So”组合得到1129分，而“L is Real 2401”仅第一行就达到2031分。Mochi64还发起挑战，邀请其他人使用相同代码寻找分数更低的答案。
这项结果是计算匹配得出的候选，并未获得任天堂确认。石碑与路易吉传闻长期相连，也与宫本茂曾透露路易吉在开发后期因内存等原因遭到移除有关；2020年泄露文件中还出现过路易吉的角色模型。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

items.summary: One Bit Horror于10月21日公布了正在开发的PC恐怖游戏《Please Remain Dead》，并开放Steam商店页面。玩家将在验尸台上持续装死，通过压制身体反应欺骗同室的验尸员。游戏开始时，玩家身盖白

content.v: One Bit Horror于10月21日公布了正在开发的PC恐怖游戏《Please Remain Dead》，并开放Steam商店页面。玩家将在验尸台上持续装死，通过压制身体反应欺骗同室的验尸员。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261021/1792574239_565395_jpg_r.jpg
游戏开始时，玩家身盖白布并被固定在台面上。验尸员认定玩家已经死亡，但仍会检查身体反应：胸口检测装置出现时需要停止呼吸，手臂被抬起时要放松肢体，灯光照向眼睛时则必须固定视线。视觉、触觉或听觉上的异常都可能暴露玩家仍然活着。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261021/1792574240_799857_jpg_r.jpg
验尸员可能把手放到玩家腹部、举起锤子或重新收紧束缚，还会记住此前发现的可疑之处，重复犯错将带来更高风险。玩家虽然遭到拘束，但仍有一只手可以活动，只能抓住验尸员转身的数秒推进脱困。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261021/1792574248_810182_jpg_r.jpg
与此同时，玩家体内还有某种异物开始像呼吸一样活动，需要用手将其压制，以免引起验尸员注意。《Please Remain Dead》的发售时间尚未确定，目前不支持日文；预告片提到了免费试玩版，但具体上线时间尚未公布。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

items.title: 9分神作爆降至5.9"烂作" 《边缘行者2》翻车 真烂完？
items.summary: 《赛博朋克：边缘行者》第二季已经于昨日正式开播，今日，该剧集豆瓣评分也正式开分，目前共有3947人参与评价，均分5.9分。

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/21/small_202610211659044686.png
《赛博朋克：边缘行者》第二季已经于昨日正式开播，今日，该剧集豆瓣评分也正式开分，目前共有3947人参与评价，均分5.9分。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/21/small_202610211659128162.jpg
编辑观点： 《赛博朋克：边缘行者》第一季凭借极具冲击力的视听表现、令人难忘的角色和悲剧性的故事，成为不少观众心中的神作。因此，第二季还未开播就背负了极高的期待。然而，续作上线后，围绕剧情表现的争议逐渐出现：相比第一季集中讲述大卫的个人悲剧，第二季采用了更复杂的群像叙事，多条故事线并行展开，却让部分观众觉得角色缺少足够的情感铺垫，剧情也没有前作那么有感染力。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/21/small_202610211659196378.jpg
认为续作翻车的观众觉得，动画再炫、打斗再精彩，也不能弥补故事本身的问题。第一季最打动人的地方，并不只是血腥暴力和赛博朋克风格，而是观众一路见证角色走向悲剧时产生的情感共鸣。如果第二季的人物关系不够深入，故事线又显得分散，那么再华丽的画面也很难复制前作带来的震撼。尤其是在第一季已经封神的情况下，观众自然会拿两季进行比较，续作的不足也就更容易被放大。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/21/small_202610211659268219.jpg
但另一种观点认为，第二季并非全面退步。TRIGGER的视觉表现、动作设计和暴力美学依然具有鲜明特色，续作也有自己的叙事方向。第二季没有继续复制大卫与露西的故事，而是尝试拓展夜之城的世界观，这本身并没有问题。真正值得讨论的是，这种改变是否成功，而不是只要没有达到第一季的高度，就应该被判定为失败。
扳机社的作画火力依旧拉满，可《赛博朋克：边缘行者》第二季的口碑，还是狠狠摔在了观众面前。豆瓣评分定格5.9，对比第一季9.0的封神成绩，落差一眼就能看见，开播之后，玩家和观众的争吵直接炸开。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/21/small_202610211659367992.png
第一季的成功其实是一场恰到好处的共振：大卫一条主线贯穿到底，在夜之城冰冷残酷的规则里，把普通人的挣扎、爱恋与毁灭缓缓铺开。观众跟着他一步步滑向赛博精神病的深渊，那份无力又揪心的悲剧感，才是整部动画真正的内核，赛博朋克的美术、利落的打戏，都只是包裹这份故事的外壳。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/21/small_202610211659445050.jpg
第二季选择了一条难度极高的路，放弃复刻大卫与露西的故事，转而铺开群像多线叙事，想要进一步拓宽夜之城的版图。但野心撑不住篇幅，多条线索并行拉扯，角色缺少充足的铺垫，人物关系来得仓促。不少观众直言观感割裂，部分桥段落入俗套的龙傲天套路，节奏松散散乱，很难再找回当初那种情绪层层堆叠、最后一击破防的冲击力。
评价自然走向两极。失望的观众观点很直接：再绚烂的分镜、再奔放的暴力美学，都救不回失了重心的剧本。夜之城最动人的底色，是凡人在强权与义体洪流里的渺小；当角色的代价变得轻飘飘，再华丽的演出都只剩空壳。前作珠玉在前，观众自带高标准，剧本上所有瑕疵都会被无限放大。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/21/small_202610211659558539.png
但另一部分声音认为，不该用第一季的模板绑架续作。Trigger的视觉功底没有滑坡，团队主动跳出成功范式、尝试拓展世界观的方向本身无可厚非。它只是一次叙事上的冒险，只是这场冒险没能圆满落地，不能单凭分数，一锤子把整部作品打死。
神作续作最难的从来不是复刻画面，而是复刻那份直击心底的悲剧重量，这次扳机社显然在故事上失手了。 你看完第二季之后，觉得是剧本彻底崩盘，还是一次可以理解的大胆尝试？欢迎在评论区聊聊你的看法。

items.title: 当屏幕中的游戏，在身边展开｜XEO 北京核聚变展台介绍

content.v: 核聚变游戏嘉年华北京站即将开幕，热门新游试玩、精彩舞台活动、限定周边收集、沉浸式体验最热烈的玩家氛围！10 月 24、25 日，我们首钢国际会展中心见！
GGG游戏节奏联欢夜为北京核聚变游戏嘉年华期间举办的夜间音乐演出活动，如需购买GGG核聚变联票，请前往GGG购票页面。
XEO 是专注于沉浸式娱乐的品牌，围绕游戏、电影与音乐，通过技术与设计，探索更深入的体验。
10 月 24—25 日，XEO 将亮相北京核聚变游戏嘉年华，带来 PC、掌机、座舱与赛车模拟等游戏体验空间，以及「4.0 环绕声系统」与「XEO Skin 磁吸声幕创意展台」，邀请玩家在声音与画面中，重新感受游戏世界的魅力。
XEO 202 + PC 体验区｜重新定义桌面的声学边界
轮廓简洁、身形小巧的 XEO 202 桌面沉浸声系统，将在有限的桌面空间里，展开澎湃声场。
在现场，玩家还可通过 XEO Dial 无线磁吸控制旋钮，以熟悉的扭转与点击，自如调节音量、切换音源，让操作自然融入体验，在强劲的声浪中畅享游戏乐趣。
https://image.gcores.com/fc30fd68e12cfb35c2e752d9db728574-4240-2832.jpg
https://image.gcores.com/b25a1db906f40b56d55698ee259fade1-4500-3006.jpg
XEO Big + 掌机体验区｜手中的世界近在眼前
XEO Big 超轻 4K+ 头显，将清晰画面与轻便佩戴融于一体，为掌机游戏打开更广阔的视野。
XEO Big连接掌机，让原本局限于手中屏幕的游戏画面，在眼前的大屏中展开。
https://image.gcores.com/ac9ac01e93cce643427f11ba4687b3d1-4500-3006.jpg
XEO Pod + XEO Big 体验区｜坐进游戏世界
XEO Pod 沉浸声娱乐座舱，将家庭影院配置集成于座舱之中。搭配 XEO Big 超轻 4K+ 头显，让游戏画面在眼前展开，声场在身边环绕。
坐进舱内，听见脚步、对白与环境声在身边响起，随眼前的画面走进故事之中。
https://image.gcores.com/4bf419824dfff7db51398a8951f4947b-4500-3006.jpg
4.0 环绕声系统体验区｜让声音，围绕身边展开
本次展台还将带来由两套 XEO 202 组合而成的「4.0 环绕声系统」与PC搭配。
四只音箱在真实空间中构筑环绕声场，进一步呈现游戏音效的方向与空间层次。从前方的动静，到身后的回响，玩家可以在现场感受游戏环境声的包围，体会置身其中的临场感。

items.title: 公会打团多人指挥用什么语音软件？2026稳定不掉线的开黑平台
items.summary: 带过团的人都知道，打团最怕的不是对面强，是自己这边先乱。几十号人挤在一个频道，指挥喊破嗓子没人听；拉人拉错房、权限一团糟；正打到关键团，语音卡成幻灯片——这种体验，带一次团就劝退一次。公会/固定团要的语音软件，说白了就三

content.v: 带过团的人都知道，打团最怕的不是对面强，是自己这边先乱。
几十号人挤在一个频道，指挥喊破嗓子没人听；拉人拉错房、权限一团糟；正打到关键团，语音卡成幻灯片——这种体验，带一次团就劝退一次。
公会/固定团要的语音软件，说白了就三个硬指标：大场面不崩、权限管得住、队员留得下。按这个标准盘一盘 2026 年的选择。
首选 NN——大团战不卡麦，还能帮你把公会做起来
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/xiaz/20261021/1792572848_949817.png
几十人大团战，语音照样稳。
NN.COM 的自研语音走电竞级低延迟通道，跨区域语音延迟能压到 50ms 以内；配合 AI 智能降噪，指挥喊话不会被键盘声、电流麦干扰。人越多越考验稳定性，NN 在多人团战场景下不掉链子。
频道/社区管理，权限拆得细。
公会可以搭多分组社区：指挥房、娱乐房、接待房间分开设，管理员、群组、角色权限都能配。谁负责拉人、谁有权限开麦、哪些房间仅成员可见，规则自己定——大公会管理不再是"谁嗓门大听谁的"。
不只是语音工具，还能沉淀公会资产。
NN 支持公会/战队建自己的社区阵地：有成员积分激励，日常活跃能攒积分、兑福利；内容、资讯、活动都能沉淀在社区里。队员不是打完全散了，而是有一个随时回来看看的"家"。
想办赛事？工具都给你备好了。
NN 有可视化办赛工具和赛事专区，公会自己也能组织比赛：报名、直播、拉票、竞猜一条龙。官方还有"星火共建计划"这类共创激励，扶持公会和 KOL 自办赛事——对想搞活公会的管理来说，这是别的平台给不了的运营弹药。
草根玩家有上升通道。
NN 与 PUBG 联合搭建 PNCL 全民晋升赛道，草根玩家、KOL 参赛胜者可直通 PCL 职业赛场。公会里真有天赋的苗子，等于多了一条被看见的路。
备选：YY / KOOK
- YY：老牌语音平台，公会频道体系成熟，功能齐全、用户基数大，适合沿用多年习惯、成员都已沉淀在 YY 的老公会。
- KOOK：频道权限管理做得细，界面简洁，端游固定小队用得多，适合中小型队伍精细化管理，但大型公会运营生态相对单薄。
总结
大团指挥选型，记住三句话：
- 要大场面稳定 + 管理精细 + 公会能持续运营 → 首选 NN，从语音到赛事工具是完整闭环；
公会成员都在 YY 上习惯多年、不想折腾迁移 → YY 仍是稳妥选项； 中小型固定队要轻量精细管理 → KOOK 够用。
指挥不崩，团魂就在。你们公会用哪款指挥？评论区聊聊踩过的坑。

items.title: UFO调查员称美墨边境现"人形掠食者" 称来自另一维度
items.summary: 莫桑团队称相机拍到白色长尾生物，华雷斯民防部门与得州警方均表示未收到相关报告。

content.v: 据英国《每日邮报》报道，UFO调查员海梅·莫桑声称，墨西哥华雷斯谷一带出现了一种会叼走并杀死鸡、公鸡和兔子的食肉生物。他的团队在当地架设相机，称拍到了这只“非人类存在”的照片：一只体型较大、通体白色、长尾、四肢粗壮的动物。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/new/content/2026/10/21/cas_auto/small_0_7001648.jpg
莫桑团队在10月17日于墨西哥举行的发布会上公布了这批影像。四名研究助理称，他们看到这只生物翻越一堵大砖墙，并参照砖块尺寸估算其从头到尾长约近六英尺，尾巴约三英尺。莫桑还表示，它敏捷、聪明，能两足行走，外形有些像人。
对于它究竟是什么，莫桑本人也没有给出确定答案。他对墨西哥媒体说，这可能不是来自另一个世界的外星生物，而是某种从另一个维度穿越而来的智能存在，并连发疑问：“它为什么出现在那里？是个谜。它们是跨维度生物吗？”
https://img1b.gamersky.com/new/content/2026/10/21/cas_auto/small_0_7001173.jpg
不过，当地官方的说法与莫桑团队并不一致。据《每日邮报》报道，华雷斯市民防部门表示，尽管10月17日已有新影像公开，他们并未收到该地区出现致命生物或动物被叼走的任何报告。美国得州一侧的警方也告诉当地媒体《埃尔帕索时报》，自莫桑10月5日首次提出这一说法以来，没有收到异常遭遇或牲畜死亡的相关报告。莫桑所谓的“有居民因害怕而搬离山谷”的说法，同样未获官方证实。
另外，莫桑在UFO话题上的过往记录也并不可靠。2023年，他在墨西哥国会展示了两具据称在秘鲁发现的“非人类”木乃伊，称其为外星生命存在的证据，但法医专家认定，这两具所谓外星木乃伊是用动物和人类骨骼配合胶水、纸张拼装而成的人造玩偶。他2007年调查的“梅特佩克生物”事件，最终也被发现是当地标本师改造的松鼠猴。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/new/content/2026/10/21/cas_auto/small_0_7001126.jpg

content.v: CYCLOPS GAMES宣布，生存类Roguelite游戏《SKROLL》已在Steam开放试玩。玩家需要不断浏览手机短视频，通过点赞或举报改变推荐算法，在电量和困意达到极限前完成每晚的目标。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261021/1792572381_539980_jpg_r.jpg
本作由Emilio Rivas、Luis Suárez和Rubén García开发，以“数字社会的奴隶”为主题。每局包含三个夜晚，每晚会在手机电量耗尽或角色困意达到极限时结束。随着进度推进，玩家必须完成的“多巴胺指标”也会不断提高。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261021/1792572383_813313_jpg_r.jpg
游戏收录超过100种具有不同效果的视频。玩家看过的内容会组成应对后续夜晚的牌组，而点赞和举报将调整之后出现的视频，使玩家逐步构筑适合自己的内容组合。无限滚动、推荐反馈和注意力消耗由此转化为资源管理与牌组构筑机制。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261021/1792572385_145795_jpg_r.jpg
《SKROLL》正式版目前计划于2027年登陆Steam，具体发售日期和售价尚未公布，现阶段也不支持日语。

items.title: 72岁董明珠：有人喊我奶奶 我很不开心
items.summary: 快科技10月21日消息，珠海市格力技工学校日前正式开课，格力技工学校校长、格力电器董事长董明珠到场，为首届新生讲授第一课。

content.v: 快科技10月21日消息，珠海市格力技工学校日前正式开课，格力技工学校校长、格力电器董事长董明珠到场，为首届新生讲授第一课。
据媒体报道，课堂上，72岁的董明珠在讲台前分享了一件趣事：某天一位学生喊她奶奶，她听了很不开心。她讲述道“你怎么能喊我奶奶呢，我还很年轻啊？”
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/21/small_202610211643351156.png
在她看来，人的价值不能用年龄来衡量，而是应该用精神来衡量。她举例称，自己三天内跑四个省份、经常凌晨一点搭乘飞机。有人劝她注意身体，她却坦言状态很好。
董明珠认为，“实际上，人老不老、累不累，取决于你内心的梦想。我们只要想去干一件事，必须要做到，你会拼尽一切力量 ！”
同时，董明珠也在课上分享了自己对人生价值的理解。她表示，“一个人成功不在于得到多少，而在于付出多少、帮助了多少人。”勉励同学们从他人的经历中汲取力量，树立正确的人生目标。
谈及技校学生的发展前景，董明珠寄语新生：技能人才同样拥有多元选择，“培养张雪这样的也可以”。
她表示：“我们毕业以后回去可以当老板，卖格力、卖空调、卖冰箱、卖洗衣机、卖家用电器，可以有更多的空间和选择。”
董明珠认为文凭不等于能力，“我觉得文凭不文凭不重要。技工学校出来的学生我觉得不弱于大学文凭。格力人未来需要的人才是什么？从我们的总部到全国各地的基地，需要技术人才，懂技术，懂营销。”
“我们要成为别人的一棵大树，而不是依赖别人的树下乘凉。”董明珠勉励同学们增强独立意识与责任担当，在提升自身能力的同时学会帮助他人，努力成长为有自信、有担当、对社会有贡献的格力人。
据了解，珠海市格力技工学校学制三年，开设九个专业，对接智能制造、电气技术、信息技术三大领域，作为一所全日制民办技工学校，该校首届招生便吸引了超8000人报名。

items.title: 成都二仙桥大爷又被交警拦下：骑电动车违规载货
items.summary: 曾在《谭谈交通》节目中走红的“二仙桥大爷”又因骑电动车违规载货被交警拦下

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/21/small_202610211640085842.png
快科技10月21日消息，据媒体报道，近日，有成都当地博主发帖称，曾在《谭谈交通》节目中走红的“二仙桥大爷”又因骑电动车违规载货被交警拦下，引发关注。
今日，谭乔向证实此事属实，谭乔转述大爷的说法称，执勤警察未对其罚款，仅要求将货物转运、消除违法行为，并提醒注意安全。
对此，成都市公安局交通管理局第四分局工作人员听说“二仙桥大爷”又被交警拦下，也感到惊讶，“过了这么多年，又被拦下来了呀！”
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/21/small_202610211640162105.png
该工作人员介绍，这种骑电动车加挂拖车拉货的行为属于违法改装，具体处罚视违法情节而定。一般处理会责令恢复车辆原状，并进行安全教育。
据悉，多年前《谭谈交通》节目中，一名大爷骑电动车违规载货，在成华大道二仙桥附近被当时还是交警的谭乔拦停检查。
谭乔问他“该走哪条道”，大爷反复回答“到二仙桥”“走成华大道”。两人不在一个频道上，一个问交规，一个答路线，全程“鸡同鸭讲”，笑料不断，成为《谭谈交通》的爆笑名场面之一。
两人的对话让“二仙桥大爷”走红网络，“你走你的成华大道，我过我的二仙桥”的段子也随之热传。
